jobs.title: Project Manager / On-Site Technical Supervisor – Fire Alarm & Fire Suppression Systems
jobs.description:
Synergy Innovative Solutions LLC (SIS), a certified Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and Women\-Owned Small Business (WOSB) federal contractor, is seeking a Project Manager / On\-Site Technical Supervisor for an anticipated federal fire alarm and fire suppression inspection, testing, and maintenance contract supporting the VA Palo Alto Health Care System. This position is contingent upon contract award. This is a hands\-on leadership role overseeing compliance, scheduling coordination, technical supervision, and government liaison work across five VA sites.

Location and on\-site requirements

* Based in the Bay Area or willing to relocate to the Bay Area prior to the start of contract performance; this is an on\-site position supporting multiple VA Palo Alto Health Care System locations
* Local travel between VA Palo Alto Health Care System sites is required
* Expected on\-site presence includes at least two full weeks per month, plus additional on\-site coverage when inspection or testing work is performed
* Must be able to support the contract's emergency\-response requirements, including up to a four\-hour on\-site response when required

What you'll do

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), including regular on\-site coordination
* Review and submit monthly compliance documentation and inspection reports
* Confirm and oversee field work scheduling performed by our systems integration subcontractor
* Ensure all work meets NFPA 72, NFPA 25, NFPA 99, NFPA 101, and Joint Commission (TJC) standards
* Maintain quality control and on\-site supervision as required under the contract's performance work statement
* Support 24/7/365 emergency response coordination

Required qualifications

* NICET Level II certification in Fire Alarm Systems
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with commercial fire alarm and/or fire suppression systems in a technical or supervisory capacity
* Working knowledge of Simplex, Notifier, and/or Edwards fire alarm platforms
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated documentation, scheduling, and coordination capabilities
* Must be able to pass a federal facility background check

Preferred qualifications

* NICET Level III or IV certification in Fire Alarm Systems
* Prior experience supporting federal government or VA facilities contracts, including COR coordination, documentation, subcontractor oversight, and contract administration
* Experience supervising or managing subcontractor field performance
* Familiarity with healthcare facility life\-safety compliance

To apply: submit a resume and copies of active NICET certification(s). Application deadline: open until filled. Position contingent upon contract award.

Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

Join our Global Security team to safeguard employees and assets with cutting\-edge security systems and expert collaboration.

* Ability to work with and manipulate data, create CSV files for upload into other systems

Morgan and Chase brands. **The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------


The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high\-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry\-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.


**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------


The Digital Transformation Analyst is a key contributor within the GP\&O Digital Transformation team, responsible for advancing planning functionality and driving business process development across global operations. This role bridges the gap between technology platforms and business stakeholders, translating operational requirements into scalable digital solutions that support end\-to\-end planning capabilities. The Analyst will work closely with cross\-functional teams — including Supply Chain, GIS, Manufacturing, Spares, Sales Operations, and Finance — to identify process improvement opportunities, define system requirements, support solution implementation, and measure outcomes against transformation goals.


The ideal candidate brings analytical rigor, strong communication skills, and hands\-on experience with planning tools (e.g., Kinaxis, SAP, or similar platforms). They thrive in an agile delivery environment and are comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


**Planning Functionality Support**


* Partner with planning teams to gather, document, and prioritize functional requirements for digital planning tools and systems.
* Support configuration, testing, and rollout of planning platform enhancements, including demand, supply, and capacity planning modules.
* Develop and maintain functional specifications, process flows, and user documentation to enable adoption of planning capabilities.
* Coordinate with GIS and system integrators to resolve functional gaps and ensure system behavior aligns with business needs.
* Monitor sprint progress, participate in agile ceremonies (daily scrums, sprint reviews, retrospectives), and track issue resolution.

**Business Process Development**


* Analyze current\-state business processes to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and digital improvement opportunities.
* Design and document future\-state process flows and governance frameworks.
* Lead or support Business Process Analysis workshops with cross\-functional stakeholders to align on process design decisions.
* Develop change impact assessments and support change management activities, including training material development and delivery.
* Establish and track KPIs and benefit realization metrics to measure process improvement outcomes.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Collaboration**


* Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring requirements are clearly understood and implemented.
* Facilitate status updates, steering committee presentations, and executive briefings on transformation initiative progress.
* Build trusted relationships across functional areas including Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and Operations.
* Support vendor and third\-party partner coordination, including review of deliverables and performance against SLAs.

**Project \& Program Support**


* Maintain detailed project plans, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and status trackers.
* Coordinate cutover, UAT planning, and go\-live readiness activities for planning system deployments.
* Support the development of transformation roadmaps aligned to organizational strategic priorities.
* Contribute to lessons\-learned documentation and continuous improvement of delivery practices.

-------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in digital transformation, planning operations, business analysis, or process improvement within a Technology or Supply Chain context.
* Hands\-on experience with planning platforms (e.g., Kinaxis RapidResponse, SAP IBP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated ability to document business requirements, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Experience supporting or participating in ERP/planning system implementations or upgrades.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau), or similar.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
**Preferred qualifications**

* Master's degree or MBA with a focus on Operations, Technology, or Strategy.
* Certifications: PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or higher), SAFe Agile, or equivalent.
* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, or similar project management and documentation tools.
* Familiarity with supply chain planning concepts (demand planning, S\&OP, capacity planning, inventory optimization).
* Exposure to change management methodologies (Prosci ADKAR or equivalent).

jobs.description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Senior Project Manager\- Personal Electronics**
=================================================


**The Group:**
--------------


**The charter of ADI’s Personal Electronics (PES) team is to lead the market in selected technology domains with highly differentiated sensing, signal processing and power solutions. Today these technology areas include Audio, Battery Management and Power which drive major growth in our portable Consumer business. With a goal to deliver sustainable growth the PES group will present the successful candidate with a great opportunity for continuous career development as part of a highly motivated and supportive team.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

  

**The Position:**
-----------------


The PES product technology group is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead teams working on the development of new product solutions for next generation portable product applications. The successful candidate will lead project development teams taking responsibility for planning, execution, and delivery from product initiation through to release of the final solution in volume to the customer.

  

  

**Responsibilities/Duties**
---------------------------


* Ensure that the appropriate level of due diligence is applied to the business justification for a project prior to the project entering the development phase.
* Co\-ordinate with key project stakeholders to define the scope, full factory cost and total development cost targets for each project plan.
* Drive project execution to meet the scope, cost, and schedule to plan. Ensure that the project schedule is maintained and key project milestones of tapeout, samples and release date are achieved.
* Work with key stakeholders to generate and actively manage a project risk register
* Ensure that each development function (Design, Test, Eval, Marketing etc.) is aware of the key milestone commitments and all critical information and changes relating to the project through team meetings and other communication.
* Manage project change requests which may fundamentally impact the schedule and cost of the project.
* Track and record in PLE the performance of the project to key milestones.
* Ensure post\-release review (AAR) of the project is completed as required and appropriate Lessons Learned are shared with all key stakeholders.
* Work directly and closely with key customers as required, scheduling and chairing regular meetings and delivering project updates as necessary.
  

  

The Candidate:


The ideal candidate must be self\-motivated, dynamic, meticulous, prepared to take the initiative and also exhibit the following skills:


* Ideally have 10\+ years’ experience in an Engineering Project/Program Manager role working with large multinational companies
* Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or equivalent
* Strong Knowledge of MS Office Tools
* Strong planning skills are essential
* Ability to drive tasks to completion through close coordination with multiple groups
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  

  

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce \- Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State \- Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

*Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.*

*EEO is the Law:* *Notice of Applicant Rights Under the Law* *.*

Job Req Type: Experienced  

Required Travel: Yes, 10% of the time  

Shift Type: 1st Shift/Days
The expected wage range for a new hire into this position is $161,700 to $234,150\.
* Actual wage offered may vary depending on work location , experience, education, training, external market data, internal pay equity, or other bona fide factors.
* This position qualifies for a discretionary performance\-based bonus which is based on personal and company factors.
* This position includes medical, vision and dental coverage, 401k, paid vacation, **holidays, and sick time** , and other benefits.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest\-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 15 rankings in ENR. With over 70 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double\-digit year\-over\-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!

  

  

  

We are seeking a Project Manager to support the delivery of multiple small\-scale capital improvement, renovation, and infrastructure projects ($1MM\-$20MM\+) with a highly technical operational environment with a leading technology client in Milpitas, CA. This individual will manage projects from planning through completion, coordinating with internal stakeholders, design consultants, and vendors to ensure successful execution while minimizing impacts to ongoing operations. The ideal candidate will have experience managing multiple concurrent projects, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to effectively navigate complex stakeholder environments. Must have R\&D lab and cleanroom experience with strong knowledge of MEP systems. Experience supporting infrastructure, technology, or mission\-critical facilities is preferred.

  

  

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities:**

* Plan, manage, and coordinate all aspects of the project schedule, scope, and cost.
* Value Engineer the project by identifying opportunities for savings and ensuring material substitutions are equal.
* Manage the on\-site project stakeholders.
* Prepare Project Management plan and fee budget/proposal at the project outset.
* Evaluate documents and communicate the client’s specific goals and expectations to all project team members.
* Develop and communicate action plans that will lead the project team throughout the project, beginning with the initial Project Management Plan.
* Re\-evaluate the contract scope of work as the project progresses against the goals, expectations, and the needs of the client, and recommend adjustments as necessary.
* Coordinate with cost management group for preparation of cost estimates, cost studies, actual job cost reviews, and budget reconciliation.
* Organize and maintain framework for project team processes and record keeping of electronic and tangible documents.
* Drive the permitting process by designing team documents to be submitted to various local, state, and federal agencies and ensure the applicable permits are moving through the process efficiently.
* Ensure the project design management continues to follow the client project documents such as budget, scope, schedule, and client's design standards.
* Prepare cost and revenue projections.
* Perform Constructability Review to determine the reasonability of a build plan.
* Develop and lead design management, procurement strategies, construction, fit\-out, and closeout.
* Contracts and claim negotiations.
* Budget development and management.
* Ability to run larger, more complex projects.
* Effectively delegate project tasks to project management team.
* Oversee the entitlement process for unoccupied construction sites to ensure appropriate zoning is obtained.
* Lead the vision for project procedures and processes for running the project.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Attendance at work during normal business hours.
  

  

**Knowledge \& Skills Required:**

* Knowledge and experience planning, managing \& coordinating all aspects of project, scope and cost for multiple projects.
* Demonstrated ability to monitor and re\-evaluate scope throughout the project and recommend adjustments when necessary.
* Experience collaborating with cost management group to provide accurate and timely cost estimates, cost studies, actual job cost reviews, and budget reconciliation.
* Experience with Value Engineering
* Ability to exercise creativity and resourcefulness in managing the project effectively in a compressed timeframe.
* Utilize effective written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to understand how your role contributes to the organization's goals.
* Deliver quality work product by role modeling organizational core values.
* Hold self accountable to individual and team goals.
* Consistently communicate and collaborate with team members and clients.
* Demonstrated ability to build positive relationships with peers, leaders, and clients.
* Proactively participate in self\-development to continually enhance current skills and build new skills required to excel at current role and prepare for career progression.
* Demonstrate ability to be dependable, diligent, and thorough.
  

  

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

Education: BS in Construction, CM, Engineering, QS, Architecture, or related field


Experience: 6\+ years of experience Project Management, engineering, or construction management


Preferred Certification: CCM, PMP, PE, AIA, LEED

jobs.title: Staff Product Program Manager, Network Expansion
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.


The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.


At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

 **What we are looking for**


Aurora's commercial trucking network is expanding. By the end of 2026, more than 200 Aurora\-powered trucks will be in driverless commercial operation across multiple freight corridors. Every new lane, endpoint, weigh station, and truck stop must clear software readiness gates spanning map development, ODD analysis, test creation, and on\-road performance before it can carry commercial freight without a driver.


The Staff PM, Network Expansion owns that picture. This role is the primary source of truth for software readiness across all active and upcoming sites, and is responsible for making that state legible to senior leadership, commercial partners, and the engineering teams accountable for closing gaps. The work requires strong technical understanding of the software readiness process, tight coordination across Mapping, Perception, Motion Planning, Systems \& Safety Engineering, and Vehicle Operations, and direct engagement with Business Development and Product Strategy to connect readiness to commercial priorities.


The commercial network will be materially larger in 18 months than it is today. A significant part of this role is building the processes and tooling to scale with it.

**In this role you will**

* **Software Readiness Ownership:** Own the definitive view of where every highway segment, customer endpoint, weigh station, border patrol station, and truck stop stands against software readiness criteria and customer commitments. This spans map development timelines, ODD analysis progress, test creation status, and on\-road performance. Keep this picture current across all active sites and ensure it is the basis for release planning and prioritization decisions.
* **Program Synthesis and Executive Reporting:** Aggregate workstream status across the lane expansion program and produce the executive software readiness update for senior leadership. Own the agenda and content for the weekly program review. Prepare and lead VP\-level decision meetings when major risks require escalation or tradeoffs need to be resolved. The output of this work is senior leadership having an accurate, decision\-ready view of the commercial network at all times.
* **Autonomy Roadmap and Commercial Alignment:** Connect commercial network priorities to autonomy capability development. Partner with Perception, Motion Planning, and Systems \& Safety Engineering to ensure the capability roadmap reflects the lanes and endpoints Aurora needs to open next. Partner with Business Development and Product Strategy to understand which sites carry the highest commercial priority and translate that into concrete input for engineering planning. When workstream slips affect the commercial schedule, articulate the business consequence clearly and identify available tradeoffs.
* **Cross\-Program Execution:** Track and unblock the engineering dependencies that determine when lanes and endpoints are ready to open. Work directly with Motion Planning, Perception, and Systems \& Safety Engineering to understand capability timelines and surface gaps that affect the expansion schedule. Work with Mapping Operations to ensure mapping work is sequenced for lane and endpoint readiness timelines. Coordinate with Vehicle Operations to ensure efficient and effective on road testing.
* **Vehicle Demand Forecast:** Partner with Vehicle Operations leadership to develop the fleet demand forecast, informing hiring decisions and vehicle allocation. Provide forward\-looking input on which lanes and endpoints will require development vehicles and when.
* **Operational Infrastructure:**Identify where current tracking and coordination processes will not scale as the network grows. Design and drive improvements to tooling and handoffs. The right person in this role will make it materially easier, a year from now, to answer "are we ready?" across a significantly larger set of routes.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Range across strategy and execution:** This role requires both executive\-level synthesis and hands\-on operational work. Strong candidates can structure a prioritization framework for a VP audience and, in the same week, build a readiness checklist, run a daily check\-in, or reconcile a tracking artifact manually. The role does not have a support layer for operational work.
* **Credibility with engineering teams**: Must understand enough about ODD analysis, test coverage, and system integration to identify when a schedule is unrealistic, determine which risks belong in an executive update, and ask effective questions in engineering reviews. This is not a role for a generalist who relies on engineers to interpret technical state.
* **Cross\-functional influence in high\-stakes environments**: Vehicle Operations, Mapping Operations, Systems \& Safety Engineering, Perception, and Business Development each have their own leadership and competing priorities. Must be able to drive alignment and accountability across these organizations without owning their roadmaps. Experience navigating multi\-team environments where you are accountable for outcomes you don't directly control is essential.
* **Comfort building in ambiguous environments**: The processes and tooling for tracking a network of this scale are still being developed. Strong candidates treat this as core work, not a gap to work around.
* **Experience with operational or physical readiness programs** (autonomous vehicles, aviation, rail, logi

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

### **About the Team**


We exist to improve Marketing leaders’ understanding and decision\-making on how to profitably grow the business. Our North Star is to increase pipeline generation by measuring key marketing and financial metrics, inferring actionable insights, catalyzing strategic investment decisions and accelerating operational efficiency across Marketing and Finance.


Our team operates at the intersection of strategy, finance, and marketing execution \- partnering closely with Growth Marketing, Brand \& Creative, Strategic Events, Product Marketing and leadership to ensure that marketing investments are efficient, effective and aligned to Snowflake’s growth priorities.

### **About the Role**


As a strategic finance partner to Snowflake’s Growth Marketing organization, you will own planning, forecasting and performance analyses across a global portfolio of marketing programs, campaigns, and events, and help leaders decide where to invest to drive pipeline and consumption growth. We are looking for a rigorous and driven senior analyst who can work autonomously, bring structure to ambiguous business questions, and influence decisions with clear financial recommendations. You will build trusted relationships with senior marketing leaders, influence decisions with clear financial insights and leverage Snowflake’s own platform to scale existing processes, increase productivity, and sharpen focus on high\-impact strategic work.

### **What You Will Do**


This role will support recurring reporting, own budgeting variance analyses, and help translate data into actionable, clear insights for Marketing stakeholders. You will collaborate closely with senior analysts and cross\-functional partners, developing the skills to navigate ambiguity, ask thoughtful questions, and continuously improve processes. This role is ideal for a proactive self\-starter with strong analytical curiosity who wants to strengthen their strategic finance acumen.

### **What You Will Need**

* 4\-7 years of experience in FP\&A, Strategic Finance, Investment Banking, or Consulting, including at least 2 years supporting a GTM organization; ideally at a Saas or consumption\-based company.
* Strong command of funnel metrics and how investments drives pipeline, bookings and consumption
* Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels
* Proven advanced ability in financial modeling, forecasting, and data analysis to support strategic decision making
* Strong sense of accountability with a proactive, solutions\-oriented approach to learning, improving, and driving work forward
* AI\-first mindset, with track record of using automation or AI to scale reporting and analyses
* Bachelor’s Degree: in Finance, Data Science, Economics, Accounting, or a related field


Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.


How do you want to make your impact?


For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com


The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

* The estimated base salary range for this role is $118,000 \- $155,400\.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.


The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.


To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager II, Google Cloud Consulting
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, driving customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a management, technical, or engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help customers successfully adopt Google Cloud products. You will lead the successful adoption of Google Cloud at organizations, guiding them through the strategic and technical facets of their Google Cloud transformation journey. You'll manage the successful delivery of Cloud Consulting engagements to drive customer adoption of Google Cloud services. In this role, you will regularly engage with various stakeholder groups, including leadership of enterprises and a cross\-functional and geographically dispersed team.


Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $140000 \- $204000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goal and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple work streams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand customer’s business, develop strategic roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
* Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with Support, Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers to ensure customer success, and work with customers and Support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Program Leader, Global Membership CX
jobs.description:
**About the Team**  

  

The **Global Consumer CX Team** owns the policies, insights, reporting, and planning behind all **Membership\-specific (non\-trip) support experiences** . Operating with a global\-first, regionally nuanced mindset, we deliver a single, coherent support experience worldwide for our flagship subscription program, **Uber One** . We blend policy architecture, experience design, and single\-threaded accountability to eliminate fragmentation, manage the persona Support P\&L, and convert customer friction directly into upstream engineering and operational requirements.
  

  

**About the Role**

* Bachelor's Degree

### **About This Role**


### **Department**


Chinese Hospital Clinics


### **Reports to**


Clinic Manager

Full\-Time/Non Exempt

12768


### **Position Summary**


This position carries out the day\-to\-day functions of patient navigation and communication. Care Coordinator manage and facilitate patients’ care and treatment plan through liaising among different ladders of health professionals and system, including but not limited to primary care, specialists, hospitalist, radiology, laboratory, infusion unit, etc.


### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Serve as the direct liaison between patients and the services they receive at primary care clinics and/or specialty care
* Respond to incoming telephone calls and emails from patients and private practices seeking care or coordinating care at Chinese Hospital Clinics
* Collect and verify insurance eligibilities; complete referral and/or authorization information for patients when appropriate
* Conduct intake assessment and navigate necessary services in designed treatment plans
* Consult and collaborate with health care providers and specialist to set up patient appointments appropriately according to scheduling and payer protocols
* Educate patients about their conditions, medications, and provide specific instructions to their treatment plans
* Maintain documentation of patient encounters and communications agreed with organization requirements
* Performs insurance verification and eligibility checks
* Follows Hospital and Department policies and procedures at all times, including but not limited to: Administrative Manual, Environment of Care, Human Resources, Infection Control, Corporate Compliance, Code of Ethics, etc.

* Ability to effectively present information, both verbal and written.
* Ability to take initiative, adapt to changing priorities, and work independently.
* Strong time management and prioritization skills.
* One to three years of experience in medical office setting.

The **Operations Coordinator** plays a vital role in supporting maintenance operations. This position ensures the seamless coordination of maintenance requests, vendor scheduling, and project support. Working closely with the General Operations Managers and Maintenance Supervisors, the Operations Coordinator prioritizes service requests and maintains compliance with maintenance standards. By streamlining processes and ensuring timely communication with residents and vendors, this role is essential to keeping a portfolio of properties running efficiently and effectively. Work is primarily conducted in person in an assigned Essex office to communicate with residents, vendors, and fellow associates in person, relying on virtual and telecommunication when that is not possible. On occasion, in\-person meetings, project management, and inspections needed on\-site at properties within the portfolio.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

* Manage and prioritize service requests using SightPlan.
* Schedule pre\-move\-out and final move\-out inspections with residents, which may be conducted in person or virtually as needs demand.
* Create purchase orders for vendor services and track vendor\-related work orders.
* Schedule vendors for unit turnovers based on inspection findings.
* Monitor unit turnover and maintenance work orders to ensure timely completion.
* Respond to onsite emergencies and coordinate with the onsite team, including providing in\-person support and coverage as needed for colleagues at other locations.
* Partner with CMS Project Manager in supporting various asset improvement and preventative maintenance projects. Be the Community Management stakeholder of each project.
* Assist in scheduling and granting property access for projects led by Project Execution and sustainability, which can require onsite presence to facilitate.
* Communicate with on\-site team and residents in person (or telephonically and virtually when not possible) to confirm work completion, gather feedback, and recommend improvements.
* Assist in purchasing supplies, equipment, and services while tracking budget variances and escalating concerns as needed.
* Other responsibilities as deemed necessary by the company as part of the ordinary course of business.

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required. College degree preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with property management or CRM software.
* Prior experience in customer service or property management is preferred.
* Commitment to providing exceptional customer service and a desire to help people.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a centralized hub environment.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.
* Capability to utilize a personal smart device for apps related to property operations and communication.
* Ability to work onsite to complete essential job functions outlined above and as arise in the ordinary course of the job.

**WHAT THE JOB REQUIRES:**

* Maintain alignment with Essex policies and procedures while effectively managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain compliance with all applicable laws, e.g., Fair Housing, Landlord Tenant, Local Building Codes, OSHA, and EEOC.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to create, compose, and edit written materials.
* Regular, consistent, and timely attendance required.
* This role requires a five\-day workweek that will likely include weekend coverage. Work is primarily performed at an Essex office location, involving extended periods of sitting at a desk or workstation, with the regular need to deliver resident notices. This may involve walking and use of stairs for prolonged periods of time.
* Travel required for occasional meetings and training.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* Decisions made with thorough understanding of procedures, company policies, and business practices to achieve general results and deadlines.
* Team\-oriented mindset with a commitment to efficiency and service excellence.
* Initiative to enhance workflows and optimize maintenance processes.
* Detail\-focused approach to tracking and managing vendor relationships.
* Strong communication skills to foster positive resident experiences.
* Ability to exercise initiative.
* Ability to meet all job requirements and assignments.

### **\#LI\-Onsite**


All full\-time regular associates are offered competitive salaries, experience career growth, and are eligible for benefit packages that include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, 401k employer match, excellence rewards, wellness programs, and much more. With our 12 paid holidays and 15 PTO days, work/life balance is a priority! Additionally, most positions are eligible for a housing discount of 20%.
Essex provides great communities in which to live, work and invest. We are a purpose\-driven company, and we pride ourselves on promoting an internal culture of growth and opportunity by engaging, enabling, and empowering our teams. Working at Essex is not a destination. It is a journey where you can confidently build your career.


New hires generally start between $26\.92 \- $31\.25 per hour. The final salary offer will be determined after reviewing relevant factors, including but not limited to skill sets; relevant experience; internal equity; and other business and organizational needs.
This role is also eligible to participate in Essex’s discretionary Annual Bonus program that is commensurate with the level of the position.

As a member of CCRM Fertility’s diverse team of professionals, you will be a part of helping families grow and changing lives. We take pride in providing our employees with meaningful employment, a supportive culture, and a well\-balanced personal \& work life alignment. For more information, visit www.ccrmivf.com

**Location Address:**

**Department:**

**Work Schedule:** Weekday – Weekday (7:30 am – 4m)

**What We Offer Our Team Members:**  

* Generous Paid time\-off (PTO) and paid holidays
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Health benefits eligible the first day of the month following your start date.
* 401(k) Plan with Company Match (first of the month following 2 months of service)
* Basic \& Supplement Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Short\-Term Disability
* Flexible spending including Dependent Care and Commuter benefits.
* Health Savings Account
* CCRM Paid Family Medical Leave (eligible after 1 year)
* Supplemental Options (Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Accident)
* Professional Development, Job Training, and Cross Training Opportunities
* Bonus Potential
* Potential for Over\-time Pay (Time and a half)
* Holiday Differential Pay (Time and a half)
* Weekend Shift Differential Pay ($4\.00 per hour)

**How You Will Make an Impact:** The Patient Access Coordinator serves as a critical link between patients and the Care Center, making a significant impact on patient experience. This vital role ensures that patients have a positive, organized, and efficient entry into CCRM Fertility, contributing to a positive patient experience and operational efficiency.

**What You Will Do:**The Patient Access Coordinator is responsible for greeting and registering patients, answering phones, collecting patient information, insurance details, completing medical record requests, and provides front office administrative support for the office. The Patient Access Representative is the first person to greet patients and will answer questions or provide general information. This position reports to the Practice Administrator.

* Greet and welcome patients upon their arrival, creating a positive and welcoming atmosphere.
* Scan insurance cards, picture identification, and prior medical records.
* Process co\-pays, procedure pre\-payments, and past due balances prior the scheduled service being rendered.
* Schedule or reschedule patient appointments, identify no shows, and promptly communicate schedule changes.
* Monitor the correspondence dashboard in Athena (Return mail).
* Complete eligibility work queues; identify incorrect insurance on file or clearing progyny inaccurate eligibility status.
* Protect confidential information and patient medical records.
* Answer phone calls, take messages, and forward based on urgency.
* Contact patients missing “New Patient” paperwork, two days prior to their appointment.
* Mail patient information and education materials.
* Monitor faxes and distribute to appropriate staff/departments.
* Maintain lobby appearance, open the Care Center, and turn on equipment prior to opening.
* Ensure the building is locked and secured at close of business.
* Other duties as assigned.

**What You Bring:**

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* 1\+ year administrative experience required.
* Previous experience in reproductive medicine or Women’s health is preferred.
* Prior experience with Athena preferred.
* Ability to work weekends, evenings, and holidays, on a rotating basis.

**Working Conditions:**The physical demands described here are representative of those which should be met, with or without reasonable accommodation (IAW ADA Guidelines), by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with others, frequently required to sit at a desk, work on a computer, and spend prolonged periods preparing and analyzing data and figures. Will occasionally stand and/or walk; use hands and fingers to grasp, pick, pinch, type; and reach with hands and arms. Employees are required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading; operation of standard office machines and equipment (computer, telephone, photocopier, and scanner).

**CCRM’s Compensation:** The salary range represents the national average compensation for this position. The base salary offered will vary based on location, experience, skills, and knowledge. The pay range does not reflect the total compensation package. Our rewards may include an annual bonus, flexible work arrangements, and many other region\-specific benefits.

**Pre\-Employment Requirements:**All offers of employment are conditional upon the successful completion of CCRM Fertility’s onboarding process, including verification of eligibility and authorization to work in the United States. This employer participates in the **E\-Verify** Program in order to verify the identity and work authorization of all newly hired employees.

**Equal Employment/Anti\-Discrimination****:** We are an equal\-opportunity employer. In all aspects of employment, including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, the choice will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Pharmacy Care Delivery, Licensed Pharmacy Technician Preferred
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**  

  

Supervises team to enact patient care and delivery internal and external quality, safety, and emergency policies, standards, and procedures. Driving maintenance that all activities adhere to regulatory rules and regulations, supervising team to assess, resolve, and assure quality outcome measures. Proactively supervises development of drug education and staff development. Organizes team workflow and executions during collaborations with care providers and members. Supervises implementation and execution of complex case\-specific drug information. Models development, implementation, and coordination of drug initiatives, formulary drug management activities, and/or KP drug\-related trials. Leads utilizations of medications to monitor impact and assure safe, rational, and cost\-effective prescribing. Supervises improvements to and coordination of complex pharmaceutical care.  

**Essential Responsibilities:**  

  

* Recommends developmental opportunities for others; builds collaborative, cross\-functional relationships. Solicits and acts on performance feedback; provides team members with feedback; and mentors and coaches to drive performance improvement. Pursues professional growth; provides training and development to talent for growth opportunities; supports execution of performance management guidelines and expectations. Implements, adapts, and stays up to date with organizational change, challenges, feedback, best practices and processes. Fosters open dialogue, supports, mentors, engages, and motivates team members on collaboration. Delegates tasks and decisions as appropriate; provides appropriate support, guidance and scope.
* Supervises and coordinates daily activities of designated work team or unit by monitoring the execution and completion of tactical action items and work assignments; ensures all policies and procedures are followed. Aligns team efforts and standards, and measures progress in achieving results; determines and carries out processes and methodologies; resolves escalated issues as appropriate. Develops work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines; coordinates, obtains and distributes resources. Removes obstacles that impact performance; identifies and recommends improvement opportunities; influences teams to execute in alignment with operational objectives.
* Leads team to carry out implementation and development of drug therapy by: overseeing efforts for proper drug use management across a team; teaching team members how to create moderately complex content regarding utilization of medicine; collaborating with senior health care providers to gather relevant sources on potential changes within the market and upcoming new drugs; collaborating across teams/functions to provide input and oversee standard pharmacotherapeutic drug regimen guidelines and trainings; guiding team to ensure members, patients and/or healthcare providers understand appropriate use, application, and interactions of prescribed medication and provides drug information to relevant healthcare providers; driving application of strategies to ensure achievement of member financial and therapeutic objectives; and evaluating teams reports of member data to assess plan outcomes and carrying out action plans to affect change.

**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.


At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**


Marvell's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) team drives a disciplined approach to identifying, assessing, and managing the risks that could impact the company's strategic objectives. Partnering across business functions and executive leadership, the team provides enterprise\-wide risk visibility, supports Board and Audit Committee oversight, and helps ensure risk\-informed decision\-making.  

  

As part of the ERM team, you will work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to advance Marvell's risk management program and integrate cybersecurity risk into the broader enterprise risk landscape.**What You Can Expect**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all ERM activity enterprise\-wide.
* Lead the full annual ERM cycle — executive stakeholder engagement, risk ranking, and report creation.
* Deliver Board\- and Audit Committee\-ready risk reporting.
* Perform periodic update cycle. Hold risk owners accountable for mitigation progress.

jobs.title: Global Capacity & Resilience Program Manager
jobs.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.



This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

**THE ROLE**



 Everpure's global contract manufacturing network needs a single owner for capacity governance and supply chain network resilience — someone who replaces fragmented, reactive decision\-making with one coherent framework spanning all lines of business. This role sits at the center of that shift: building the governance structures, risk frameworks, and executive reporting that let the network absorb shocks — geopolitical, infrastructure, business continuity — without derailing growth targets. You'll work closely with the Network Design Council, site managers, CM partners, and cross\-functional teams like Mfg Product \& Test Engineering, R\&D Engineering, and Indirect Sourcing, with real influence over how capacity and risk decisions get made across the network.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own and govern the Global Capacity Planning Framework, building the RACI that gives the Supply Chain Network Council one source of truth across all lines of business
* Serve as the central escalation point for capacity issues network\-wide, running a Monthly Global Capacity Review and standardized dashboards that keep site managers and CM partners aligned
* Define and govern Time to Recover (TTR) and Time to Survive/Time to Fail (TTF) resilience KPIs across all global production sites and products, translating gaps into prioritized mitigation plans for the highest\-risk sites
* Drive the Capacity Analysis Tool and executive Tableau dashboard roadmap, and own the capital budget that funds capacity and resilience investments against growth targets
* Partner with Indirect Sourcing and Engineering to optimize test process \& time, landed cost through data research, common infrastructure parts and improved CM pricing and forecasting


**WHAT YOU BRING**


* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or related field; Master's degree preferred. Six Sigma Green Belt certification or above preferred.
* An industrial process engineering mindset — comfortable applying process analysis, simulation, optimization/heuristics, or forecasting to translate operational data (cost, service, capability, emissions) into network design decisions.
* Proven ability to lead complex, technically\-oriented transformation projects, utilizing methodologies like Waterfall, Agile, or Scrum to manage scope, schedules, and deliverables in a dynamic environment, paired with exceptional communication and negotiation skills to translate technical/data concepts for non\-technical stakeholders and build consensus across supply chain, IT, and engineering teams.
* Deep fluency in global contract manufacturing capacity planning, built through experience designing governance frameworks, RACIs, and executive review cadences that hold up across a complex, matrixed network
* Strong analytical capability — comfortable building capacity models and KPI dashboards in tools like Tableau, and partnering with BI/analytics teams on executive\-facing reporting
* Experience building supply chain risk and resilience programs, including business continuity planning, scenario analysis, and recovery metrics such as Time to Recover and Time to Survive/Fail
* Skilled at driving alignment across cross\-functional, matrixed teams without direct authority — able to influence site managers, CM partners, and senior stakeholders toward a shared framework
* We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara, CA office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

  



\#LI\-ONSITE



\#LI\-MC3

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:**


* **Innovation**: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

jobs.title: Park Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
The Operations Specialist supports the day\-to\-day operation of Children’s Fairyland including Rides \& Admissions and Retail and ensures safety standards are maintained throughout the park. The position ensures all guests enjoy a fun, safe and memorable experience by training and supporting Park Ambassadors to succeed in their roles. Reporting to the Park Operations Manager, responsibilities include working closely with other departments and vendors, acting as a key responder for escalated park issues, and end of day cash handling.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------


### **Rides \& Admissions**


* Ensure Rides, Admissions and Gatekeeper positions are appropriately staffed to meet operational needs.
* Act as a subject matter expert in CFL safety procedures and regulations
* Monitor the performance of Ride Operators including adherence to all safety procedures and regulations, daily cleaning, managing height requirements;
* Monitor the performance of Admissions Staff and ensures cash handling and park policies are followed;
* Troubleshoot and resolve problems by contacting the appropriate departments and/or vendors as needed for resolution
* Collect daily ride sheets and report any ride issues to Park Operations Manager
* Ensure staff and guests comply with CFL park policies and regulations
* Manage end\-of\-day cash handling at various locations throughout the park

### **Day to Day Operations Support**


* Daily cash handling and Point\-of\-Sale issues and adjusting staff to operational needs. Cash handling responsibilities include preparing bank deposits, preparing change banks and collecting funds from donation boxes around the park.
* Regular daily observation of ride operations and guest service.
* Conduct frequent show walks to monitor the cleanliness of the park and employee areas.
* Administrative duties include running reports, documenting accidents, maintaining inventory, maintaining accurate records of daily ride sheets, updating daily attendance, and submitting the daily EOD report to Senior Leadership.
* Administer first aid and CPR in emergency situations
* Report safety and maintenance issues to Facilities Department
* Assist in the sweeping and clearing the park of guests
* Support special event production
* Support the MOD (Manager on Duty) to oversee the park as needed
* Scheduling of Park Ambassadors personnel to ensure all areas are adequately covered

### **Customer Service**


* Respond to customer issues including providing answers to guest inquiries, addressing guest concerns, issuing refunds and rainchecks
* Walk the park and monitor guests and staff
* Act as a lead and make decisions for customer service escalation

### **Supervision**


* Oversee all functions of Park Ambassadors.
* Support Park Ambassador Lead with daily operations
* Provide coverage to Park Ambassador Lead during scheduled rest periods
* Coordinate staff training including New Hire Orientation, ride operator training and cross training.
* Monitor park ambassador performance, coach and counsel staff
* Document performance issues and coordinate additional training as needed.
* Communicate all issues to the Park Operations Manager.
* Assist in handling staff shortages, recruiting and hiring.
* Schedule, train, and monitor the performance of Park Ambassadors;
* Partner with Retail Sales Manager to cross\-training Park Ambassadors
* Contribute to Daily Lineup Notes and Weekly Staff Guide
* Other duties as assigned

**Knowledge Skills \& Abilities**
---------------------------------


* Minimum 2 years’ experience leading a team of ten (10\) people or more in a busy, customer service based environment. Experience in an amusement park, museum or similar hospitality environment is preferred.
* Associate’s Degree or equivalent preferred
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Proven ability to work in a multi\-faceted, fast paced, customer\-facing environment
* Intermediate level computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel and Google Workspace application suite
* Experience with POS systems and cash handling procedures
* Ability to track and maintain accurate records on multiple items and meet deadlines
* Flexible and adaptable to constantly changing and challenging situations including weather, crowd size, staff shortages, occasionally having to work past scheduled hours
* Possession of a clear background history with no barriers to working with children
* Current Infant/Child/Adult First Aid \& CPR Certification

  


### **Personal Attributes/Values**


* People\-orientation\- able to interact effectively, politely, and productively with all types of people from all types of backgrounds and experience and in all types of situations. Comfortable working with non\-English speaking and culturally diverse stakeholders
* Professional maturity to manage composure during stressful interactions
* Energetic, diplomatic, adaptable and with a good sense of humor.
* Passionate about the mission, vision, and goals of Fairyland and possess an understanding of how this position contributes to the organization’s success.
* Strong work ethic with an orientation toward constant innovation and process improvement.
* Impeccable integrity and honesty

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------



This position is primarily located in an outdoor environment. Able to perform the following duties with or without accommodation:


* Stand, sit, kneel, walk, bend, and perform repetitive motions for the duration of an eight (8\) hour shift
* Traverse safely over uneven terrain throughout the entirety of the 10\-acre amusement park
* Safely lift and transport items of up to 50 lbs.
* Respond quickly to sounds
* See and respond quickly to situations
* Communicate in clear, loud voice
* Operate two\-radio for communications with park personnel
* Work in outdoor, seasonal weather conditions for 100% of shift

------------


At Affinity, we're passionate about our customers' success and looking for a resourceful, results driven Customer Success Specialist to join our Scale team. This role blends two things: managing a large, global portfolio of Scale customers day to day, and helping build the scalable, one to many programs that let a lean team deliver a great experience across a much larger book than a traditional 1:1 CSM model allows.


You'll manage a book of Scale accounts as part of a pooled model, driving adoption, mitigating renewal risk, and expanding revenue, while also building the playbooks, programs, triggers, and campaigns that not only support activation for the Scale book, but also for the whole customer base. You'll partner closely with Scale CSMs, CS Ops, Product, and Lifecycle Marketing to make sure the customer journey feels coordinated from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

**Account management**

* Manage a large and global portfolio of customers, including CRM workflow support, renewal risk, and revenue expansion opportunities.
* Leverage high touch and one to many tactics to drive positive customer outcomes and help users work Affinity into their daily tech stack.
* Mitigate risk by proactively identifying and flagging churn risk early in the contract cycle.
* Maintain a deep understanding of the product and make workflow recommendations to drive adoption and engagement.
* Proactively identify customers who may not be maximizing Affinity and engage them to drive up monthly active users and seat expansion.
* Work cross functionally to provide effective and productive customer engagements.
* Function as the voice of the customer, identifying trends and feeding them back internally.

**Program design and journey work**

* Help design and continuously improve programs across the Scale customer journey, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

* Help identify the highest leverage touchpoints and design campaigns, in app messaging, and outreach sequences that move accounts through activation milestones.

**Measurement and reporting**

* Take a data first approach to designing and implementing engagement strategies at scale.

* Use data (Salesforce, Amplitude, etc.) to prioritize which accounts need attention and which programs to build next.

* Operate with the pace and iteration mindset of a hyper growth CS org: ship a program, measure it, adjust it.

* Track record of achieving commercial targets and goals, preferably in an enterprise SaaS setting.
* Experience managing high volumes of accounts at scale, driving adoption and renewals.

* Proficient in organization, account prioritization, project management, and time management.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and programs simultaneously, and ship in a fast paced, high growth environment.
* You are excited by the startup environment and enjoy contributing to a team that's still building out its structure and process as it scales.

**Nice to have**

* Experience at a SaaS company in the CRM or data services space.
* Experience with financial services clients, or in VC, private equity, investment banking, or other private capital verticals.
* Proficiency with tools like Salesforce, AI first CS platforms like Sonora, marketing automation tools like Customer.io or Pardot, Notion, and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar).

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds with our most strategic customers to build production AI systems on Claude. The team takes on work where no playbook exists yet, turns what works into repeatable patterns for partners and our field teams, and brings what it learns back to Product and Research. Demand for FDE is well ahead of the team's capacity, and the team is growing quickly across the Americas, Europe and Asia.



We're hiring a dedicated Strategy \& Operations Lead for FDE. You'll be the strategy partner to FDE leadership and own the plan: headcount and capacity, the mix of work the team takes on, how engagements are priced and measured, and how more of the work moves to partners. You'll run the business reviews and build the reporting leadership uses to make these calls.



You'll sit on our GTM Strategy \& Operations team, dedicated full time to FDE. You'll work closely with Finance, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Partnerships and Applied AI, and with the FDE program leads who run pre\-sales and delivery. This is a hands\-on role. You'll build the models and dashboards yourself and use Claude to automate as much of the reporting as you can.


**Key responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* **Own the plan.** Build FDE's annual and quarterly plan: headcount and hiring by region and role, capacity, utilization, and the mix of commercial, research and mission\-driven engagements.
* **Model demand and capacity.** Build the demand, capacity and staffing models behind the plan, with scenarios leadership can use for hiring and prioritization decisions.
* **Run the business reviews.** Lead FDE's monthly and quarterly reviews. Set KPIs with FDE leadership, own the scorecard, and write the materials for GTM and company leadership.
* **Build the reporting.** Work with Revenue Operations and Data Science to get engagement, staffing and outcome data into our systems so reporting runs without manual work. Measure what engagements lead to: production launches, consumption, expansion, and patterns partners reuse.
* **Shape the commercial model.** Partner with Finance, Deal Desk and Legal on how FDE engagements are priced, packaged, discounted and contracted, and track the economics of the portfolio.
* **Scale through partners.** Build the plan and the economics for moving more work to delivery partners: which engagements partners own, co\-deliver or get Anthropic advice on, what capacity they need, and how we measure their quality and cost.
* **Design the org.** Work with FDE leadership and People on new roles, manager spans and where new headcount lands as the team grows.
* **Lead cross\-functional projects.** Take on questions that span Sales, Applied AI, Customer Success, Product and Research, from defining the problem through to a decision and a working process.

* Have worked in strategy and operations, business operations, strategic finance or consulting, including direct work with a professional services, implementation, solutions engineering or forward deployed team
* Understand how a services business makes and loses money: utilization, staffing mix, rates, backlog and margin, and how they connect to customer outcomes
* Can build a capacity or staffing model from scratch, explain every assumption in it, and pull the data yourself with SQL
* Have run planning cycles and business reviews for a senior leader and written the materials yourself
* Have taken an unclear question to a recommendation, a decision and a process that other teams still use
* Earn the trust of senior technical and commercial leaders and can influence them without direct authority
* Are comfortable working fast with imperfect data and simple processes that you improve as you go
* Use AI tools in your own work today and want to push that much further
* Are excited about Anthropic's mission to build AI that is safe and beneficial

**Preferred qualification:**
----------------------------


* 10\+ years in GTM strategy and operations, business operations or consulting
* Built the operations of a professional services or FDE team through a period of fast growth
* Worked on services pricing, statements of work and deal terms with Finance and Legal
* Built or managed delivery partner programs, including subcontracting, co\-delivery and partner economics
* Experience in a consumption or usage\-based business, including tying services work to product usage
* Enough technical fluency to talk with engineers about how LLM applications are built (agents, evals, MCP)
