Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com


**An award\-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:**


* TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026\)
* Fortune Change the World (2024\)
* CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024\)
* Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024\)
* Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024\)
* Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023\)
* Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024\)
**About the Role:**



Maven is looking for a Member Services Specialist to take on our most complex and sensitive member cases.



A few examples: a member's reimbursement is denied and she wants it reviewed again mid\-IVF cycle, while her clinic is asking for payment. Her Wallet card declines at the pharmacy, leaving her $900 out of pocket. Her employer changes plans two weeks before a scheduled transfer. Each case involves money, medical timelines, and a high level of trust.



These cases live in claims, appeals, and reimbursement territory. We're looking for someone who already has hands\-on experience in that world — ideally someone who has served as the point of escalation on their current team — rather than someone who will build those skills here.



You'll own cases like these from first contact through resolution, by phone and in writing. You'll also handle everyday support volume, including appointment changes, login issues, enrollment questions, and partner programs. The mix shifts with demand, so breadth matters as much as depth.



Our Member Services team supports Maven members 7 days a week. The shifts we're hiring for are listed below in EST.


* Monday–Friday, 1:00 p.m.–9:30 p.m.
* Tuesday–Saturday, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. weekdays; 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Saturday
* Tuesday–Saturday, 10:00 a.m.–6:30 p.m. weekdays; 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Saturday
* Tuesday–Saturday, 1:00 p.m.–9:30 p.m. weekdays; 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Saturday
* Sunday–Thursday, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. weekdays; 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Sunday
* Sunday–Thursday, 1:00 p.m.–9:30 p.m. weekdays; 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m. Sunday


**What You'll Do:**


* Own complex and sensitive cases end to end, including appeals, denied claims and applications, coverage loss, COBRA, deductible disputes, and urgent care needs.
* Take member calls on specialty workflows, including conversations that have already gone badly.
* Understand what a member is actually asking for and apply the right workflow—knowing, for example, that a denial question and a formal appeal may require different handling.
* Owning complex and sensitive cases end to end, including appeals, denied claims and applications, coverage loss, COBRA, deductible disputes, and urgent care needs
* Taking member phone calls on specialty workflows, including the conversations that have already gone badly
* Read what the member is actually asking for. A question about a denial can look identical to a request for a formal appeal, but the two require different handling — the same goes for a denied application versus a denied claim.
* Investigating before you reply. Pull the history, find where it broke, and come back with an answer instead of a status update
* Keeping members updated on their timeline rather than ours when a case takes days or weeks
* Explaining coverage, eligibility, and reimbursement rules in language a member can act on, without promising an outcome you do not control
* Driving cases that need Jira, Compliance, a clinic, or a benefits administrator to finish, and staying on them until they do
* Knowing what is yours to solve and what needs to move, and handing off with enough context that nobody restarts your work
* Carrying general support volume alongside the complex work as demand shifts across programs and channels
* Noticing what members keep running into, and bringing it to your manager with a fix in mind
* Working your assigned shift, including evenings, overnights, weekends, and holidays


**What You'll Bring:**


* 3\-5 years of experience in claims processing, appeals, medical billing, or benefits/health plan operations — you've actually worked on denials and payment disputes, not just heard about them.
* Experience serving as the point of escalation on a support or claims team at an employer benefits company — the person cases got routed to when a standard rep couldn't close them.
* A demonstrated habit of investigating before responding: pulling history, finding where a case broke, and coming back with an answer rather than a status update.
* Ability to explain coverage, eligibility, and reimbursement rules in language a member can act on, without promising outcomes you don't control.
* Experience driving cases that depend on other teams — Compliance, clinics, benefits administrators, or a ticke

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world\-renowned care begins with world\-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family\-centered care. **Job ID:** P146450\-3251

The Assistant Patient Care Manager is responsible for assisting the Patient Care Manager with clinical management and administrative coordination of a designated patient care unit(s) or service(s). The Assistant Patient Care Manager provides consistent and timely information and feedback to the Patient Care Manager and is responsible for knowledge and application of all personnel policies and requirements of the collective bargaining agreements. jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**


Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

 **About the role**


Crowe’s Metals \& Materials Consulting practice is expanding, and we are seeking an experienced **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Consultant** to help shape the future of our D365 practice. This role offers the opportunity to lead solution architecture, influence major transformation initiatives, and work directly with finance and operations leaders across manufacturing and distribution organizations.

  

If you want meaningful impact, autonomy, and a clear path to practice leadership, this is a strategic career opportunity—not just another consulting role.

 **What You Will Lead and Influence**

* Architect and lead end\-to\-end D365 Finance solutions that deliver measurable outcomes for mid\-market and enterprise clients.
* Advise senior stakeholders, including CFOs and Operations leaders, to define requirements and design transformation roadmaps.
* Set solution direction and guide delivery teams to ensure projects meet scope, quality, and client expectations.
* Lead functional design, feature optimization, data integrity, and user experience improvements to maximize platform value.
* Participate in quality reviews and steer project teams through design, prototyping, and deployment phases.
* Contribute to Crowe’s methodologies, accelerators, and best practices; mentor team members; and support the growth of our D365 offering.
* Engage in team\-building and internal initiatives, leveraging non\-client time for personal development and practice enhancement.

 **What Makes Crowe a Strong Career Move**

* **High\-impact role** with direct influence on solution strategy and client outcomes.
* **Rapidly growing D365 Finance practice** backed by a nationally recognized consulting brand.
* **Clear advancement path** into Solution Architect, Industry Lead, or Practice Leadership roles.
* **Strong investment in your development** (certification support, training, conferences, thought leadership opportunities).
* **Collaborative culture** that values quality, innovation, and balanced workloads.
* **Flexible work environment** with predictable, project\-based travel (25%–50%).

 **Experience That Makes You Successful (Must\-Have)**

* Bachelors degree required.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on D365 Finance implementation leadership or equivalent ERP delivery experience.
* Proven track record delivering complex, full\-lifecycle D365 Finance projects.
* Strong functional expertise across core finance and operational modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash/Bank, Reporting, etc.).
* Ability to lead solution architecture, translate requirements into actionable designs, and guide teams through execution.
* Excellent communication skills with experience engaging C\-suite and director\-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, produce high\-quality work products, and lead engagements with minimal oversight.

 **Preferred**

* Experience in Manufacturing or Distribution environments; Metals industry exposure highly valued.
* Strong functional expertise across operational modules (Procurement, Inventory, etc.).
* Experience with complementary ISV solutions within the D365 ecosystem.
* D365 certifications in Finance or related modules; CPA, CMA, or CFA a plus.
* Prior consulting experience within a professional services environment.

 **Why You’ll Thrive Here**

* Opportunity to shape the direction of the D365 practice.
* Access to diverse and challenging client environments.
* Supportive leadership that values initiative and thought leadership.
* Competitive compensation with performance incentives.

 *We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening!*

 *\#LI\-Hybrid*

jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Specialist, Americas
jobs.description:
### **About Ahrefs**



Ahrefs is an all\-in\-one marketing intelligence platform used by marketers, businesses and agencies around the world. Our tools help people understand search demand, analyse competitors, improve website performance and research content opportunities, backed by 15 years of web crawling data and increasingly powered by AI.



We're bootstrapped and profitable, and we have been for 15 years. There are no investors and no board, which means no outside timeline on our decisions. We're multinational, with offices in Palo Alto, Cambridge (MA), Singapore and Tokyo, and our culture is fast\-moving, low\-ego, and built on smart decisions and ownership.


### **The role**



We're looking for an Enterprise Implementation Specialist to own the technical support and implementation after an enterprise customer signs.



That's the whole job, and it's a big one. You'll take a brand\-new Ahrefs Enterprise account from contract to fully live: setting up the account, migrating their keyword sets across from whatever they were using before, and running the onboarding training. When something breaks or someone gets stuck, you're who they reach. When renewal comes around, the reason they say yes is largely the work you did in the first ninety days.



You'll work directly alongside our Account Managers. They own the account strategy and the commercial relationship: where the customer is heading and what they need. You own making it real. It's a genuine partnership, and it only works if both halves are strong.



This role is based out of one of our offices, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). You can be based in whichever you have the legal right to work in, but this is an on\-site role. You'll serve customers across the Americas.


### **What you'll do**


* Run hands\-on account setup for new enterprise customers, configuring projects, workspaces, permissions and integrations to match how each customer actually works.
* Own keyword migrations end to end: audit what they have, map it across, move it, validate it, and make sure nothing quietly went missing.
* Deliver onboarding training to customer teams, from the SEO practitioners to marketing managers.
* Be the technical escalation point for your accounts: triage support requests, dig into the actual problem, resolve what you can, and drive what you can't to the right people internally.
* Turn what you learn into reusable assets (migration playbooks, training materials, documentation) so the tenth implementation is faster than the first.
* Feed real customer friction back to Product.

### **Must have**


* 3\-5 years in customer support, implementation, onboarding, technical account management, or a comparable hands\-on post\-sale role at a SaaS company.
* Direct experience taking enterprise customers live. You've owned a go\-live, not just supported one.
* Genuine comfort with data migration work: mapping, transforming, validating, and explaining to a customer why their 40,000 keywords came across as 39,847\.
* The ability to run a training session and have the attendees leave able to do the thing.
* Real technical range: APIs, integrations, CSVs, spreadsheets at scale, and the instinct to reproduce a bug before escalating it.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* The ability to figure things out independently.
* AI must be a part of your daily workflow.
* A "first do it, then do it right, then do it better" mentality. The tenth implementation should be faster or smoother than the first.

### **Nice to have**


* Working knowledge of SEO: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits, backlinks. You don't need to be a practitioner, but you should know what a customer means when they say their crawl budget is a problem.
* Hands\-on time with Ahrefs, or with a competing enterprise SEO platform.
* Experience with enterprise onboarding at scale.
* Experience working next to an account management or CS function.

### **What success looks like**


**In 6 months:** you'll be running enterprise implementations independently, start to finish. Account Managers will be routing technical questions to you by default rather than escalating them upward.


**In 1 year:** you'll be the person who knows more about how enterprise customers deploy Ahrefs at scale than anyone else in the company. You'll have a clear process and a view of where implementation should be automated rather than repeated.



Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third\-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we'll let you know.


**Location:** Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On\-site.


Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

jobs.title: Global Policy and Governance Manager - Trust and Safety
jobs.description:
**About the Role and Team**  

  

As an advocate of Safety at Uber, you will have the opportunity to identify and launch programs that help ensure a safe experience for Consumers, Drivers and Delivery Drivers, across our global marketplace and various product offerings.
  

  

We are seeking a self\-starter to join Uber's Global Safety team to focus on the development of Uber's global safety policies and standards, and governance over how safety incidents are reported, classified, routed, and audited for high\-quality reporting. This includes setting requirements for safety incident auditing, evolving policies and models to detect patterns of fraud or abuse, and
  

  

You should be comfortable in an "all hands on deck" environment, love solving problems, thrive in a hyper\-growth culture, and above all be passionate about the safety of people and the cities in which we operate. Working with teams across the globe, you'll need excellent stakeholder management, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, as well as the ability to clearly communicate and present information to seek executive buy\-in.
  

  

**What You'll Do**
* **Policy Development:** Develop robust platform safety policies and procedures across our Mobility and Delivery lines of business, ensuring alignment among stakeholders with diverse interests. Guide policy operationalization efforts in partnership with cross\-functional stakeholders to increase adherence to our Community Guidelines. Proactively use data, research, and community insights to evaluate existing policies, identify improvement opportunities, and drive revisions before issues escalate.
* **Governance \& Risk Mitigation:** Conduct risk assessments, establish and enforce governance frameworks, and develop controls to manage risks throughout the safety data reporting lifecycle.
* **Problem Solving:** Proactively identify and address emerging issues, using a data\-driven approach for issue identification, root cause analysis, and understanding of safety controls performance. Measure the impact of these issues to prioritize and advocate for cross\-functional resourcing of scalable solutions.
* **Collaborate to Solve Problems:** Maintain regular communication with senior leaders to update them on emerging safety issues and ensure that mitigation strategies are appropriately prioritized and resourced. Work collaboratively across various teams at Uber, including Product, Data Science, Safety Support, and Legal, to devise effective solutions.
* **Communication \& Influence:** Craft and convey clear and persuasive narratives from complex data and analyses to influence high\-level discussions.

**What You'll Need**
* Fluency in data analysis and data\-driven decision\-making, including proactively using data to surface policy improvement opportunities
* Ability to design processes in a fast paced environment without a prescribed template
* Ability to drive consensus and actionable results across highly cross\-functional teams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects under competing pressures
* Must be a flexible self\-starter who is comfortable with rapid changes and a fast\-paced environment
* Passion for Safety as it relates to all parties interacting with the Uber platform

**Basic Qualifications:*** A minimum of 4 years of tech industry or consulting experience in project or program management or operations/strategy roles
* Strong program and project management skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; Influential with great presentation skills and the ability to tell clear, compelling stories out of complex issues and analysis
* Experience managing cross\-functional projects and stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience developing platform policies for tech companies
* Experience in Trust \& Safety, Risk, Marketplace Integrity, Fraud

jobs.title: Office Manager / Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Office Manager/Executive Assistant**

  

Become a Part of the Child Advocates of Silicon Valley Team



Child Advocates works to ensure every foster child in Silicon Valley, who has been abused, neglected and/or abandoned, has the nurturing support and resources needed to thrive. We are looking for people who put children first. People whose compassion leads to hard work and impact. At Child Advocates, it’s about each person bringing skills and passion \- their best \- so that we can be there for every foster child.

  

About the Role



We’re looking for an Office Manager/Executive Assistant to join our administration team. This role will ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations, including facilities management, vendor coordination, and general workplace upkeep. The Office Manager/Executive Assistant will also provide executive administrative and scheduling support to the CEO, helping to manage calendars, meetings, special projects and Board of Directors needs. They will also oversee all office vendors, supplies, and processes to maintain an efficient and welcoming work environment. Additionally, they serve as the main point of contact for staff and visitors, supporting both organizational needs and executive priorities.

  

How You’ll Have an Impact



The Office Manager/Executive Assistant will be responsible for:


* Managing the CEO’s calendar, including scheduling meetings and appointments, coordinating RSVPs and meeting logistics, arranging refreshments and materials, taking and distributing meeting notes, and tracking follow\-up and action items
* Coordinating CEO travel, reservations, mileage and expense reporting, and other executive administrative needs
* Preparing agendas, presentations, slide decks, meeting materials, and other documents for the CEO and organizational meetings, and providing meeting technical support, including managing Zoom and screen sharing
* Coordinating Board of Directors and Board committee meetings, including scheduling, RSVPs, meeting materials, communications, logistics, and follow\-up
* Maintaining Board records, including rosters, terms, meeting documentation, archives, and supporting new Board member onboarding
* Managing daily office operations, including office supplies, mail and deliveries, shared spaces, meeting rooms, and general workplace organization, ensuring a professional, organized, and welcoming environment for staff, guests, and stakeholders
* Overseeing facilities\-related needs, including building maintenance, office security, repairs, and other workplace needs, and communicating relevant updates to staff
* Managing vendor relationships, coordinating service appointments, maintaining vendor information and records, and tracking work through completion
* Maintaining administrative systems, standard operating procedures, templates, shared files, contact lists, and other organizational resources
* Coordinating recurring office and administrative activities, including staff recognition, gift card distribution, deposits and incoming funds, and other general administrative needs
* Making deposits and logging incoming funds when needed


**Agency Support**


* Participating in agency events and activities
* Participating in agency projects and initiatives

Completing all other duties as assigned by the Chief Executive Officer and/or Associate Director of Operations  
* 

  

What We’re Looking For


**Experience**


* Minimum education of two years of college or equivalent
* At least five years of office management, executive support, or administrative leadership
* Nonprofit experience or comparable experience
* Experience working within or supporting the foster care system preferred


**Skills**


* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and projects of varying complexity concurrently
* Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion
* Demonstrated advanced proficiency in Google Workspace, Zoom, and other online platforms and administrative systems
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to independently research and resolve day\-to\-day operational and technology issues
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage details accurately and follow through on responsibilities in a fast\-paced organization
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
* Demonstrated ability to establish effective working relationships with individuals at various levels of responsibility, including Board members, staff, vendors, and community partners
* Bilingual, Spanish\-speaking preferred

  



Important Details


**Supervisor**: Associate Director of Operations


**Status**: Full\-time, non\-exempt


**Location**: In person, in office – San Jose, California


**Salary range**: $34\.13/hr \- $37\.01/hr – Salary commensurate with experience, informed by the Fair Pay for Northern California Nonprofits Compensation \& Benefits Survey Report.


**Benefits**: Full medical, dental, vision coverage for the employee; holidays; and paid time off (PTO).

 *Applicants must be able to work a variety of hours, including evenings and weekends.*


*Applicants must have a valid California Driver’s License and current automobile insurance.*


*Applicants must be able to successfully pass a formal background check: FBI, DOJ, CACI, DMV.*


*Applicants must be able to complete CASA Volunteer pre\-service training within six months of hire.*

Proofpoint is a global leader in human\- and agent\-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

jobs.title: Sales Onboarding & Programs Manager
jobs.description:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud\-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real\-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi\-site visibility.


You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast\-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

**About the Role**
------------------


Coram AI is growing quickly, with **frequent new\-hire cohorts and an expanding sales organization**, and we’re looking for a Sales Onboarding \& Programs Manager to own and evolve the programs that help our sellers ramp faster and perform at a higher level.


Reporting directly to our Senior Director, Strategy \& Operations, you will own the coordination and delivery of Sales onboarding end to end: managing cohorts, facilitators, certifications, communications, readiness tracking, and the overall new\-hire experience. As we continue to scale, you’ll build the systems and processes that allow us to onboard sellers frequently while maintaining a consistently high bar for customer readiness.


Beyond onboarding, you will design and execute high\-impact sales programs across our **outbound\-heavy sales motion**, helping sellers become stronger at prospecting, pipeline generation, discovery, demos, qualification, and deal progression. You’ll also support enablement across Coram’s growing **channel motion**, helping ensure sellers understand how to effectively work with and through partners.


You’ll leverage AI, seller performance data, and field insights to identify opportunities, measure program effectiveness, and connect enablement programs to measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership and cross\-functional GTM teams to align programs to the highest\-priority business needs.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

* Own Sales onboarding from pre\-boarding through ramp, including scheduling, facilitation, SME coordination, certifications, communications, and follow\-up.
* Coordinate and deliver **frequent onboarding cohorts** as the Sales organization continues to grow rapidly.
* Track seller readiness and ramp progress, giving managers clear visibility into where reps are excelling and where additional coaching or support is needed.
* Continuously improve onboarding based on seller performance, manager feedback, new\-hire feedback, and evolving business priorities.
* Build programs that strengthen Coram’s **outbound sales motion**, including prospecting, pipeline generation, cold calling, discovery, demos, qualification, and deal progression.
* Build and support enablement programs that help sellers effectively navigate Coram’s **channel and partner motion**.
* Partner with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, and top\-performing sellers to turn what works in the field into scalable, repeatable plays.
* Define clear success metrics before programs launch and measure impact beyond attendance or completion.
* Use sales data and AI\-powered insights to identify performance gaps, prioritize enablement opportunities, and assess program effectiveness.
* Build scalable processes, playbooks, certifications, and operating rhythms that allow Coram to maintain a high performance bar as the organization grows.
* Facilitate live training, workshops, certifications, and field programs for sellers and sales leaders.
* Travel periodically for onboarding, team events, field enablement, and other company or Sales organization programs.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* New hires become customer\-ready and productive faster, even as onboarding cohorts increase in frequency and size.
* Managers have clear visibility into rep readiness, ramp progress, and areas requiring coaching.
* Sellers consistently execute the behaviors required to generate high\-quality outbound pipeline.
* Sales programs drive measurable improvements in seller behavior, pipeline creation, and revenue performance.
* Sellers are equipped to effectively leverage Coram’s direct and channel motions.
* Best practices from top performers become repeatable across the field.
* Enablement programs are measured by business impact, not activity alone.
* Coram can continue scaling its Sales organization without sacrificing onboarding quality or seller readiness.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Programs, Revenue Enablement, Sales Strategy, or a related GTM role.
* Experience owning or supporting B2B SaaS sales onboarding in a **high\-growth environment**.
* Experience supporting an **outbound\-focused sales organization** and a strong understanding of modern prospecting and pipeline\-generation motions.
* Strong program management, facilitation, and cross\-functional leadership skills.
* Ability to use sales data to identify performance gaps and measure program impact.
* Strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle, from prospecting through close.
* Experience with channel or partner\-led sales motions is a plus.
* Comfortable facilitating live sessions and working directly with sellers and sales leaders.
* Comfortable building programs and processes while the organization, product, and go\-to\-market motion are evolving quickly.
* Willingness to travel periodically based on onboarding, field, and company needs.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* 100% Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance
* Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays
* 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options
* Early\-stage equity in a rapidly growing company
* Referral bonuses
* Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off\-sites
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)

**Join our team and make a difference in peoples lives!**

We're looking for a **Lead Care Managers** for the **Alameda County area!**

**Job Specifics:**

* **Job classification:** Non\-Exempt, 20 hours per week
* **Job Location:** Position will be working from both remote home office and field locations in the Alameda County, CA area.
* **Pay:** $28\.40 per hour

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built One STEP at a time. Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.




**About us**


LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program

Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance

The **Lead Care Manager** under the direction of the Cal AIM Services Director, assists and aids members with enhanced coordination of care.

* Promote and live out the LifeSTEPS workplace values of integrity, innovation, empowerment, respect and personal growth in tandem with the Oz Principles.

* Identify and help to overcome barriers to adherence to care plan.

* Advocate and refer members to community resources, human services and other organizations as needed.
* Compile records and prepare reports.
* Submit claims to Managed Care Plans (MCP’s) for all member services when required.
* Maintain all required client data in the mylifesteps.org database on a continuous, regular basis. Ensure entries are up to date prior to each weekly supervision call.

* Review service plan and perform follow ups to determine quantity and quality of services provided members and status of member cases.

The Technical Expert II (TE II) is a child welfare subject matter expert working collaboratively with TEs and project leadership and is responsible for ensuring the design and delivery of training and technical assistance (T/TA) and deliverables for/with JBS projects and initiatives. The TE II *may* also be called upon to supervise project\-affiliated JBS staff.


The ICWA Partnership and Implementation Lead serves as NCWCIA’s primary implementation support lead within the cross\-center ICWA Technical Assistance Collaborative. The lead works directly with State/County, Tribal, and court partners participating in Community\-Based Partnerships and other ICWA technical assistance activities to strengthen the implementation of the Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA). The position serves as a bridge between the ICWA Technical Assistance Collaborative and NCWCIA’s broader service array, helping partners translate ICWA requirements into sustainable policies, practices, workflows, supervision structures, data systems, and continuous quality improvement efforts.


**In this role, the ICWA Partnership and Implementation Lead will be expected to:**


* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with Tribal, State/County, and court partners participating in the ICWA initiative.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and implementation advisor for State and/or county child welfare agencies participating in Community\-Based Partnerships (CBPs), ICWA technical assistance activities, and Title IV\-B ICWA implementation efforts.
* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of partner needs related to ICWA implementation, including inquiry and notice, active efforts, placement preferences, qualitied expert witnesses (QEWs), transfer of jurisdiction, AFCARS implementation, and State/County\-Tribal\-Court collaboration.
* Assist jurisdictions in translating ICWA requirements into day\-to\-day practice through policy review, workflow development, implementation planning, and problem\-solving.
* Collaborate with Children’s Bureau (CB) partners and CB funded technical assistance providers to support coordinated cross\-center technical assistance.
* Support Community\-Based Partnership teams through planning, facilitation, implementation support, follow\-up, and coordination of resources and expertise.
* Work with NCWCIA Data and CQI staff to help partners use AFCARS and other data to strengthen implementation, monitor progress, and inform continuous improvement efforts.
* Identify opportunities to connect jurisdictions with NCWCIA expertise in prevention, permanency, workforce, community and systems insights, performance and outcomes, peer networking, and continuous quality improvement.
* Support the development of implementation tools, workflows, practice guides, resource materials, and other products that emerge from Community\-Based Partnerships and peer learning activities.
* Provide content review and input on reports, presentations, implementation plans, and technical assistance products.
* Serve as a collaborative partner in identifying emerging implementation challenges, promising practices, and opportunities for innovation across jurisdictions.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Maintain professional expertise in assigned content areas and remain current on emerging issues, policies, regulations, evidence\-informed practices, and trends relevant to child welfare, human services, and the Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA).
* Design, deliver, and support high\-quality training and technical assistance activities that meet client, contract, and project requirements.
* Maintain communication with clients, partners, consultants, and project staff; participate in meetings and provide consultation, guidance, and recommendations regarding effective technical assistance approaches.


* Collaborate with project leadership, technical experts, and partners to identify needs, analyze challenges, support problem\-solving, and develop strategies for improving system performance and outcomes.
* Support the planning, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of project activities, ensuring timely completion of deliverables and technical assistance commitments.
* Identify and communicate emerging issues, promising practices, lessons learned, and opportunities for innovation to clients, partners, and project staff.
* Facilitate collaboration and information\-sharing across partners and projects to support coordinated service delivery and learning.
* Develop, contribute to, and review written products and deliverables, including reports, presentations, tools, guidance documents, meeting summaries, and technical assistance materials.
* Guide and support project staff, consultants, and partners in carrying out technical assistance activities and may supervise staff as assigned.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation of technical assistance activities in accordance with project and contractual requirements.
* Participate in project planning, quality improvement, proposal development, and business development activities as assigned.

* Master’s degree in relevant field.

* Demonstrated knowledge of ICWA implementation, Tribal\-State\-child welfare partnerships, and child welfare system improvement efforts.
* Experience working with Tribal Nations and Tribal child welfare programs.
* Experience providing technical assistance, consultation, facilitation, coaching, or practice improvement support.
* Experience supporting implementation of federal child welfare requirements and initia

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast\-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.



We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.



Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

 **To be eligible for this role you must be able to work remotely and reside only in the approved states of FL, GA, ID, NC, TX, WA \& MI.**
### **Your Responsibilities:**



HR Operations \& Systems


* System Ownership: Support the administration and optimization of Workday and other HRIS tools; troubleshoot issues and ensure data integrity across the platform.
* Lifecycle Support: Execute the operational transactions of key employee milestones, including compensation adjustments, promotions, terminations, and onboarding.
* Data \& Analytics: Design and maintain real\-time dashboards; provide actionable reporting on turnover, headcount, and other key organizational metrics.
* Process Engineering: Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and document workflows to scale HR operations effectively.


  

Benefits \& Wellness Administration:
* Program Management: Lead the day\-to\-day administration of global health and wellness programs, acting as the primary point of contact for employee inquiries.
* Financial Oversight: Execute the benefit reconciliation process and ensure accurate, timely processing of all carrier billing.
* Leave of Absence (LOA): Coordinate and track leave programs (FMLA, Disability, etc.) ensuring a supportive experience for employees and compliance with all regulations.
* Perk Optimization: Assist in the evaluation and rollout of employee perks to enhance the overall employee value proposition.

Compliance \& Governance:
* Regulatory Filings: Direct the preparation and submission of information required for EEO\-1, ADA, FMLA, and Department of Labor audits.
* Policy Development: Draft or revise internal HR policies to ensure they remain current with changing local, state, and federal labor laws.
* Audit Readiness: Maintain rigorous documentation standards for OSHA and other governmental reporting requirements.
### **Your Qualifications:**

* Experience with Workday and other HR Systems such as absence management software, ticketing tools, etc.
* Demonstrated experience supporting corporate health and wellness benefits as well as leave of absence programs
* Strong mindset for continuous improvement, process streamlining, increasing efficiency and meeting or exceeding client expectations
* Proven project management and operations skills with demonstrated ability to manage global projects and initiatives
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with proven ability to organize and analyze data, using HRIS systems for reporting
* Ability to establish strong relationships and credibility at all levels and geographies throughout the organization and cross\-functionally
* Comfort with ambiguity; ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Broad knowledge of HR functional disciplines (e.g., organizational development, talent management, employee relations, staffing, and compensation/benefits)
* In\-depth understanding of federal, state and local laws relating to HR
* A Bachelor's degree with 3\-5 years of directly relevant experience in HR/Benefits Operations


### **Benefits of Working at Rover.com**

* Competitive compensation
* 401k match
* Long\-term incentive plan with a company performance\-based cash payout
* Flexible PTO
* Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Commuter benefits
* Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
* Pet benefits, including $1000 toward adopting your first dog or cat
* Stocked fridges, coffee, soda, and lots of treats (for humans and dogs) and free catered lunches monthly
* Regular team activities performed in\-person and virtually
### **Compensation:**

* In the greater Seattle area the first\-year salary range is $91,485\-$117,902\. In Washington State outside of the Seattle area the first\- year salary range is $83,168\-$107,183\. Additionally, Rover offers a long\-term incentive plan with a company performance\-based cash payout and benefits to full\-time employees.
* The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

jobs.title: Spacecraft Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose and Primary Objectives:**


Benchmark Space Systems is looking for an analytically minded, results\-driven **Spacecraft Program Manager** to join our Mission Success team and lead the next phase of one of Benchmark's core spacecraft programs. This role sits at the center of the program, working closely across the company, our customers, subcontractors, and internal cross\-functional teams to deliver successful program outcomes.


In this role, you will develop, analyze, and manage detailed development and delivery plans, program deliverable documentation, production schedules, material procurement plans, and program reporting metrics. You will serve as the primary customer\-facing representative for the program and coordinate critical activities across functions ranging from R\&D and engineering to production, supply chain, and finance. This is an ideal role for someone with strong analytical skills, a talent for organizing complexity into easily executable work, and a drive to deliver results.


This role can be based onsite at our Burlington, VT or Pleasanton, CA offices, or remote for candidates located in the Boulder, CO area.


**About Benchmark:**


At **Benchmark Space Systems**, we're pioneering the future of in\-space mobility. Our propulsion technologies provide satellites the ability to maneuver, avoid collisions, and maximize mission potential—all while contributing to a safer, more sustainable space environment.


Backed by recent funding and a growing slate of new flight contracts for government and commercial customers, we're building a workplace where bold ideas and passionate people thrive. Engineers, innovators, and problem\-solvers at Benchmark tackle some of the toughest challenges in spaceflight, working together to turn cutting\-edge concepts into real\-world solutions. If you're ready to help shape the next era of spaceflight, there's never been a better time to join Benchmark Space Systems.


**Measurements of Success/Primary Job Responsibilities:**


At its core, Benchmark is an entrepreneurial, fast paced organization. In this environment, we need all employees to solve problems, not be afraid to ask questions and be able to work with and help colleagues in different departments and positions by digging in and working on other tasks as needed/assigned depending on business needs. With that said, there are primary job responsibilities and measurements of success for this position, which are:


* Lead the program team in developing and managing program schedules, resource plans, material procurement plans, risk analyses, and budgets.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing representative; manage contractual requirements, change management, technical interchange meetings, program review meetings, and formal deliverables.
* Oversee subcontractor and supplier performance; negotiate and manage statements of work, ensure on\-time delivery of critical path items, and resolve issues that threaten schedule or cost.
* Ensure effective coordination of program activities and communications across geographically distributed cross\-functional and multi\-company teams.
* Conduct regular program reporting, including monthly program updates and reforecasts of labor and material spend plans.
* Regularly communicate program status and plans with other internal program managers, team leaders, customers, and subcontractors.
* Escalate meaningful risks, issues, and opportunities to leadership in a timely and effective manner, including an assessment of options and a recommended path forward.
* At times, actively manage detailed production schedules in coordination with the Operations and Supply Chain teams.
* Support preparations for customer visits and meetings.
* Ensure rigorous compliance with agency\-specific policies and security classification guides.
* At all times, maintain Benchmark's outstanding reputation for operating at the highest levels of honesty, integrity, accountability, and transparency.

**Education and/or Experience:**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering (aerospace, electrical, or mechanical preferred), or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of professional experience in the high\-technology or engineering industry, including program/project management of technical products.
* Demonstrated experience managing government contracts from capture/proposal through execution and closeout, including programs with significant subcontractors.
* Experience with:
* + Scope definition and program planning, earned value management, risk management, schedule management tools, and financial controls.
	+ Wrike, MS Project, or similar planning tools.
	+ MS Excel and PowerPoint, or similar tools.
	+ Building the data\-driven tools needed to plan, analyze, and communicate program plans and status.
* **U.S. Person Requirement:** Due to the nature of the work and access to export\-controlled information, applicants must qualify as a U.S. Person under U.S. export control laws. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position now or in the future.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**


What you bring to the position, or have the ability to swiftly learn and be successful in:


* Ability to organize complex work into easily executed work tasks.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
* A record of delivering results even in the face of unexpected challenges.
* Timely, high\-quality delivery of assigned tasks, with quick and clear communication of what is needed for completion, risks or challenges to completion, and options to address them.
* The ability to effectively manage and communicate schedule, budget, and technical information throughout the company and to customers and subcontractors.
* Ability, agility, and can\-do attitude to work in an entrepreneurial, fast\-paced, and matrixed cross\-functional environment.
* Able to collaborate in a multi\-team e

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**Company Description:**


Raftelis helps local governments and utilities thrive by providing management consulting expertise to help transform local governments and utilities. We've provided professional consulting services to more than 700 organizations in the last year alone. We work in all areas of management consulting including finance, assessment, communications, technology, executive recruitment, and strategic planning.


We're proud to share that Raftelis has been certified as a Great Place to Work®! As one of our employees said, “at Raftelis, we maintain a great balance between hard work and allowing staff to focus on their lives outside of work. We also have a strong culture where people genuinely care about each other, and leadership is committed to doing what's best for both our employees and the firm”.


**Job Summary:**


Raftelis created Rafio, an AI agent built to make the people who serve utilities and local governments more capable, delivering intelligence they can trust and stand behind. The Customer Success Lead owns the post\-sale relationship: developing the agreement for new clients once demo and interest have been established, then owning that relationship from kickoff through confident, independent daily use and beyond. This is a hands\-on, technical customer success role. The single biggest driver of sustained usage is integration: connecting Rafio to the systems and data a customer already utilizes. You will be expected to scope, build, and troubleshoot those integrations yourself, working alongside other team members. You will also serve as the liaison between the client and the platform team, quarterbacking requests and triaging work to the right people when a need falls outside your direct support. You will report directly to the Chief Technology Officer, own the function solo at the start, and build a team as the customer base grows.


Success in this role is measured by usage that grows, customers who trust the output enough to lean on it, and a retention\-and\-expansion trajectory that becomes a revenue engine for the company.


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Develop the client agreement once demo and interest have been established, converting engaged prospects into signed customers.
* Own onboarding end to end: take a newly signed customer from kickoff to confident, independent daily use.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the client and the platform team: quarterback requests, triage issues, and direct work to the right team members when a need falls outside your direct support.
* Deploy the platform inside the customer's real, often messy environment, rather than waiting for a clean hand\-off.
* Scope, build, and troubleshoot integrations that connect Rafio to the customer's existing systems and data, since integrations are the critical driver of usage\-based growth.
* Carry a net revenue retention and expansion target: drive growing usage across each account, identify expansion opportunities, and act on them.
* Earn and protect customer trust with a risk\-averse, accountable buyer, ensuring the output is correct and defensible because trust is the foundation of the relationship.
* Build the repeatable systems a solo function needs to scale: self\-service resources, documentation, onboarding playbooks, training, and tooling.
* Run customer enablement and education so users become proficient and self\-sufficient, not dependent on support.
* Close the loop with product: translate what you see in real deployments into clear, prioritized feedback for the engineering team.
* Build and lead the customer success team as the customer base grows.
* Other duties assigned

**Requirements:**


* Hands\-on technical ability. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to build. You can scope and wire an integration, work through an API, read documentation, and troubleshoot why a connection is not behaving, without waiting for someone else to do the technical part. On a small team, the person who owns success also helps on the platform.
* Change management understanding. You have stood up software inside someone else's environment before, where the data was messy and the process undefined, and you made it work. You are drawn to getting a customer genuinely live and using the product, not to managing a relationship from a distance.
* The ability to earn trust with a careful buyer. You have worked with risk\-averse, accountable customers, in government, education, healthcare, finance, or another high\-trust, regulated setting, and you understand that with this buyer, correctness and credibility come before everything else.
* An owner's mindset about retention and growth. You think in terms of durable, growing usage and expansion, not just keeping accounts from leaving. You have owned a number, a book of business, or a unit's outcomes before, and you are energized by being accountable for whether usage and revenue grow.
* A process and scaling mentality. Before you scale yourself with headcount, you scale yourself with systems: documentation, self\-service, repeatable playbooks, and better tooling. You have built the operational backbone that lets a small function serve a growing customer base.
* A product sensibility. You notice where a new user gets lost and you care about the first\-run experience. You can turn what you observe in real deployments into clear, useful feedback that makes the product better.
* A teacher's patience. You can take a non\-technical user from confused to confident, and you would rather build a customer who is self\-sufficient than one who depends on you. Prior experience teaching, training, or building enablement is a strong plus.
* Alignment with our mission. We serve organizations that exist to serve their communities. You share the conviction that better tools in the hands of those operators improve the everyday lives of the people they serve.

We are open to candidates from a wide range of industries and backgroun

jobs.description:
Overview:

BerryDunn is seeking a Staff Consultant \- Project Coordinator to join the **Medicaid Practice Group**. As a Staff Consultant, you will accelerate your professional and personal growth through learning and collaborating with Medicaid Practice Group leaders. In this role you will learn to provide services to State Medicaid Agencies as they work to manage and mature their programs.  

As a Staff Consultant \- Project Coordinator you will initially be responsible for meeting preparation and follow\-up, meeting notes, maintenance of the project's SharePoint site and related project logs, and support for project deliverables. Your initial duties will include taking and distributing meeting notes; tracking action items, issues, risks, and decisions; supporting the development of PowerPoint presentations; preparing and distributing meeting agendas; and supporting the development of project deliverables.  

The successful candidate will be expected to learn quickly, be flexible, prioritize with ease, and be a great team player. Excellent relationship and communication skills are vital to the success of this role. **Travel Expectations:** This role requires travel up to 25% of the time with additional flexibility to travel as client needs arise.
You Will:
* Provide project coordination support
* Perform a wide variety of analytical tasks with continuous improvement of processes, personnel, organization, system or training
* Prepare and distribute meeting agendas and notes
* Collaborate with team to develop project deliverables
* Track, monitor, and maintain project action items, decisions, risks, and issues within project logs
* Maintain awareness of project status
* Support engagement\-wide communications
* Proactively participate in team and client related meetings
* Manage project SharePoint site
* Perform assigned administrative tasks efficiently and effectively
* Uphold firm quality standards
* Establish and achieve development and performance goals

jobs.description:
Overview:

The Customer Experience Specialist \- CO₂ Refrigeration Systems is responsible for leading the service, installation, start\-up, diagnosis, and repair of advanced refrigeration, heating, and air\-conditioning systems used in supermarkets, convenience stores, and cold storage facilities. This exempt role requires the consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in evaluating system performance, determining appropriate solutions, and prioritizing work to meet customer and business needs.

  

The position also serves as a technical leader and trainer, providing expertise in CO₂ refrigeration systems while supporting operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and business growth.


Responsibilities:

This role operates within a growing CO₂ systems business expected to represent a significant portion of future operations. The position directly supports customers and contractors in the adoption, implementation, and optimization of CO₂ refrigeration systems, influencing customer satisfaction, operational performance, and revenue growth.

* Lead installation, configuration, and start\-up of supermarket refrigeration systems, with a specialized focus on CO₂ systems and advanced controls, exercising discretion in execution and problem\-solving.
* Collaborate with and provide technical direction to technicians during complex system start\-ups and commissioning activities.
* Evaluate system performance and workplace efficiencies, making recommendations that directly impact profitability, service delivery, and customer outcomes, including warranty resolution.
* Working directly with Engineering to serve as a subject matter expert and trainer, coaching and developing technicians on CO₂ technology, refrigeration processes, diagnostics, controls, and best practices.
* Assess customer needs and identify service and sales opportunities; support service management by developing material and labor estimates and recommending solutions.
* Ensure accurate, timely, and professional completion of documentation, including work orders, service reports, and electronic communications.
* Apply advanced knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, HVAC operations, EMS programming, and complex schematics to diagnose and resolve system issues.
* Independently troubleshoot and resolve complex and non\-routine service issues, determining appropriate repair strategies.
* Analyze and apply knowledge of compressor operations, oil systems, pressure controls, and related components to optimize system performance.
* Demonstrate advanced expertise in CO₂ refrigeration systems, rack and condenser controls, low ambient systems, heat reclaim, refrigerated displays, VFDs, and new store start\-ups.
* Support large\-scale system implementations, including new retail store launches and CO₂ adoption initiatives.
* Perform additional duties consistent with the level and scope of the role.


Qualifications:
* High school diploma or equivalent required; graduate certification in HVAC/R
* EPA 608 Universal Certification or equivalent
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in supermarket refrigeration systems, with 5 years of CO₂ systems experience
* Demonstrated ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in complex technical environments
* Advanced knowledge of refrigeration principles, electrical systems, and system controls
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Ability to lead projects, train others, and interact effectively with customers and internal teams

jobs.description:
**About the Company**



Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada's solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.



With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12\), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI \- rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.



Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

 **About the Role**



We are seeking a Senior Sales Strategy \& Operations Manager to own the go\-to\-market operating cadence for Armada's global sales organization. This role sits within the Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Director, Sales Operations. This role will serve as a key business partner to Sales Leadership, Finance, Deal Desk, and members of the larger RevOps team, ensuring that our sales organization is optimized for scale, efficiency, and predictable growth across our suite of offerings. It serves as the operational backbone for territory and capacity planning, forecasting, pipeline management, and sales performance reporting across our hardware and software portfolio.



The role carries two mandates. The first is the recurring operating rhythm of the business: forecast management, pipeline inspection, territory design and calibration, quota allocation, and the reporting sales leadership runs the business on. The second is transition support as Armada's business units evolve, including planning for evolving or new lines of business and the territory, quota, and compensation that accompanies it.



This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants ownership of key planning workstreams rather than a narrow analytical lane. The ideal candidate is analytically rigorous, thrives in ambiguity, and drives to decisions quickly. You'll join at a pivotal moment, helping build the operating model that scales Armada's sales organization as it brings edge AI infrastructure to customers around the world.

  



**Location.** This role is remote\-based on the continental US.

* Support monthly and quarterly business reviews, translating performance data into clear narratives and recommended actions
* Maintain and refine the reporting structure and format sales leadership depends on, including dashboards and recurring deliverables, and recommend definitions of core revenue metrics
* Own the forecast operating rhythm for business unit(s): call preparation, roll\-up, commit and category hygiene, and forecast accuracy tracking over time
* Drive pipeline hygiene and the inspection cadence across regions and business units
* Build capacity, headcount and ramp models that size the sales organization against revenue targets

* Develop compensation scenarios and market benchmarking to support plan design
* Administer the sales compensation platform, including plan configuration, period close and payout validation
* Support business unit evolution and creation, including territory and quota re\-cuts, compensation plan migration, roster splits, and data and systems separation inputs
* Apply AI tools and automation in support of GTM strategy, and to accelerate recurring analysis and reporting
* Partner with RevOps, Accounting and Finance, People, and Engineering teams with clear ownership boundaries across each

  


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's Degree required; a Master's Degree may substitute for two years of experience
* 8\+ years of experience in sales strategy, sales operations, revenue operations or an equivalent analytical function; consulting, banking and corporate strategy backgrounds welcome
* Demonstrated ownership of territory design, quota allocation, capacity modeling and forecast management
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including modeling, pivot tables and formula\-driven analysis
* Working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM
* Ability to translate complex, ambiguous analysis into concise narratives for senior leaders, and to influence and persuade key partners outside your own function
* Comfort operating with limited structure, and a builder's instinct for establishing process where none exists
* Demonstrated discretion handling compensation and other sensitive data

  


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting complex, multiparty sales motions to critical heavy industrial or defense customers
* Hands\-on experience with a sales compensation platform such as CaptivateIQ, Xactly or Spiff
* Experience supporting a business unit creation or separatio

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**
Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose\-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.


When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry. **Vision Statement**
Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime. **Mission Statement**
Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers. **Core Values*** We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions \+ work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer \+ our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service \+ add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.
  

Ask five people on a product team why a launch slipped and you'll get five different partial answers: Engineering thought Product had locked scope, Product assumed Sales already knew what was changing, and Sales is finding out today, from a customer, that something they promised isn't shipping the way they described it. That gap between good people doing good work is where this job lives, and we need someone who can't stand leaving it open.


As the **Senior Product Operations Manager** at Assembly Software, you'd be the product manager for how our Product organization runs. Not a coordinator keeping a status doc updated, and not a process owner for its own sake, but someone who treats how our PMs, designers, and engineers plan, prioritize, launch, and learn as a product in itself, with real customers, real friction points, and real room to get better. You'll build the scorecards leadership can read without asking anyone for an update, run the readiness process that makes sure Sales and Customer Success know what's shipping before it ships, and use AI daily in how you actually work, not as a line in a strategy deck.


We're not hiring this role to keep the trains running on time; we already have that. We want someone who looks at how Product, Engineering, and Design work together and can't help but see exactly what's slowing them down, then goes and fixes it, whether or not it was technically their job. You'll move comfortably between a spreadsheet and a hard conversation with a VP about why a process needs to change, and you'll know when to retire your own mechanism because it's stopped earning its place.


We're fully remote, no surprise return\-to\-office memo hiding in the offer letter, with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), and paid parental leave. You'd be joining a small, sharp Product team that takes real pride in what it ships and is ready to hand you real ownership from day one.


If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

 **When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:** **1\. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  

Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

 **2\. What makes Assembly Software different?**  

Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000\+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

 **3\. What's the benefits package like?**  

Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program


We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.
