new_jobs.title: Park Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
The Operations Specialist supports the day\-to\-day operation of Children’s Fairyland including Rides \& Admissions and Retail and ensures safety standards are maintained throughout the park. The position ensures all guests enjoy a fun, safe and memorable experience by training and supporting Park Ambassadors to succeed in their roles. Reporting to the Park Operations Manager, responsibilities include working closely with other departments and vendors, acting as a key responder for escalated park issues, and end of day cash handling.


**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities**
----------------------------------------


### **Rides \& Admissions**


* Ensure Rides, Admissions and Gatekeeper positions are appropriately staffed to meet operational needs.
* Act as a subject matter expert in CFL safety procedures and regulations
* Monitor the performance of Ride Operators including adherence to all safety procedures and regulations, daily cleaning, managing height requirements;
* Monitor the performance of Admissions Staff and ensures cash handling and park policies are followed;
* Troubleshoot and resolve problems by contacting the appropriate departments and/or vendors as needed for resolution
* Collect daily ride sheets and report any ride issues to Park Operations Manager
* Ensure staff and guests comply with CFL park policies and regulations
* Manage end\-of\-day cash handling at various locations throughout the park

### **Day to Day Operations Support**


* Daily cash handling and Point\-of\-Sale issues and adjusting staff to operational needs. Cash handling responsibilities include preparing bank deposits, preparing change banks and collecting funds from donation boxes around the park.
* Regular daily observation of ride operations and guest service.
* Conduct frequent show walks to monitor the cleanliness of the park and employee areas.
* Administrative duties include running reports, documenting accidents, maintaining inventory, maintaining accurate records of daily ride sheets, updating daily attendance, and submitting the daily EOD report to Senior Leadership.
* Administer first aid and CPR in emergency situations
* Report safety and maintenance issues to Facilities Department
* Assist in the sweeping and clearing the park of guests
* Support special event production
* Support the MOD (Manager on Duty) to oversee the park as needed
* Scheduling of Park Ambassadors personnel to ensure all areas are adequately covered

### **Customer Service**


* Respond to customer issues including providing answers to guest inquiries, addressing guest concerns, issuing refunds and rainchecks
* Walk the park and monitor guests and staff
* Act as a lead and make decisions for customer service escalation

### **Supervision**


* Oversee all functions of Park Ambassadors.
* Support Park Ambassador Lead with daily operations
* Provide coverage to Park Ambassador Lead during scheduled rest periods
* Coordinate staff training including New Hire Orientation, ride operator training and cross training.
* Monitor park ambassador performance, coach and counsel staff
* Document performance issues and coordinate additional training as needed.
* Communicate all issues to the Park Operations Manager.
* Assist in handling staff shortages, recruiting and hiring.
* Schedule, train, and monitor the performance of Park Ambassadors;
* Partner with Retail Sales Manager to cross\-training Park Ambassadors
* Contribute to Daily Lineup Notes and Weekly Staff Guide
* Other duties as assigned

**Knowledge Skills \& Abilities**
---------------------------------


* Minimum 2 years’ experience leading a team of ten (10\) people or more in a busy, customer service based environment. Experience in an amusement park, museum or similar hospitality environment is preferred.
* Associate’s Degree or equivalent preferred
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Proven ability to work in a multi\-faceted, fast paced, customer\-facing environment
* Intermediate level computer skills with working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel and Google Workspace application suite
* Experience with POS systems and cash handling procedures
* Ability to track and maintain accurate records on multiple items and meet deadlines
* Flexible and adaptable to constantly changing and challenging situations including weather, crowd size, staff shortages, occasionally having to work past scheduled hours
* Possession of a clear background history with no barriers to working with children
* Current Infant/Child/Adult First Aid \& CPR Certification

  


### **Personal Attributes/Values**


* People\-orientation\- able to interact effectively, politely, and productively with all types of people from all types of backgrounds and experience and in all types of situations. Comfortable working with non\-English speaking and culturally diverse stakeholders
* Professional maturity to manage composure during stressful interactions
* Energetic, diplomatic, adaptable and with a good sense of humor.
* Passionate about the mission, vision, and goals of Fairyland and possess an understanding of how this position contributes to the organization’s success.
* Strong work ethic with an orientation toward constant innovation and process improvement.
* Impeccable integrity and honesty

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------



This position is primarily located in an outdoor environment. Able to perform the following duties with or without accommodation:


* Stand, sit, kneel, walk, bend, and perform repetitive motions for the duration of an eight (8\) hour shift
* Traverse safely over uneven terrain throughout the entirety of the 10\-acre amusement park
* Safely lift and transport items of up to 50 lbs.
* Respond quickly to sounds
* See and respond quickly to situations
* Communicate in clear, loud voice
* Operate two\-radio for communications with park personnel
* Work in outdoor, seasonal weather conditions for 100% of shift

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Reltio®, an SAP Company, we believe data should fuel your success in the enterprise AI era. Our Context Intelligence Platform turns fragmented data into a trusted, connected context so AI agents and systems can act with expert\-level judgement at enterprise scale. Reltio's cloud\-native SaaS platform harmonizes, unifies, and governs data across sources and formats—including unstructured data—in real time, turning them into data assets that can be mobilized in milliseconds to any application, user, or AI agent. Trusted by more than 200 of the world's largest brands across industries such as life sciences, financial services, healthcare, and technology, we fuel frictionless operations and help enterprises accelerate innovation and reduce risk.



At Reltio, our values guide everything we do. With an unyielding commitment to prioritizing our "Customer First", we strive to ensure their success. We embrace our differences and are "Better Together" as One Reltio. We are always looking to "Simplify and Share" our knowledge when we collaborate to remove obstacles for each other. We hold ourselves accountable for our actions and outcomes and strive for excellence. We "Own It". Every day, we innovate and evolve, so that today is "Always Better Than Yesterday". If you share and embody these values, we invite you to join our team at Reltio and contribute to our mission of excellence.



Reltio has earned numerous awards and industry and analyst recognition for our technology, our culture, and our people. Reltio was founded on a distributed workforce and offers flexible work arrangements to help our people manage their personal and professional lives. If you're ready to work on unrivaled technology where your desire to be part of a collaborative team is met with a laser\-focused mission to enable digital transformation with connected data, let's talk!


**Job Summary:**



The Reltio Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for driving customer adoption and retention, mitigating risk, and providing guidance and thought leadership for our customers throughout their relationship with Reltio. You will serve as the primary post\-sale point of contact after implementation and use in\-depth knowledge of the products being sold, the customer industry and/or business processes, and technical expertise to facilitate adoption and utilization of Reltio products. You will inspire and guide customers towards meeting their goals through delivering unified, interoperable data to their business. As a CSM at Reltio, you will be the champion of our customers, building and maintaining strong relationships to ensure their success on our platform and the retention and growth of our customer base.


**Job Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Account management for large enterprise customers to help them gain value from Reltio as measured by retention, adoption, growth, and customer advocacy.
* Provide required visibility into Customer health by identifying adoption opportunities and retention risk to align internal teams around customer's success.
* Build a comprehensive understanding of customers' business goals and objectives, crafting a strategic success plan that aligns with and supports the achievement of those goals

As we continue to scale, you’ll build the systems and processes that allow us to onboard sellers frequently while maintaining a consistently high bar for customer readiness.


Beyond onboarding, you will design and execute high\-impact sales programs across our **outbound\-heavy sales motion**, helping sellers become stronger at prospecting, pipeline generation, discovery, demos, qualification, and deal progression. You’ll also support enablement across Coram’s growing **channel motion**, helping ensure sellers understand how to effectively work with and through partners.


You’ll leverage AI, seller performance data, and field insights to identify opportunities, measure program effectiveness, and connect enablement programs to measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership and cross\-functional GTM teams to align programs to the highest\-priority business needs.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

* Own Sales onboarding from pre\-boarding through ramp, including scheduling, facilitation, SME coordination, certifications, communications, and follow\-up.
* Coordinate and deliver **frequent onboarding cohorts** as the Sales organization continues to grow rapidly.
* Track seller readiness and ramp progress, giving managers clear visibility into where reps are excelling and where additional coaching or support is needed.
* Continuously improve onboarding based on seller performance, manager feedback, new\-hire feedback, and evolving business priorities.
* Build programs that strengthen Coram’s **outbound sales motion**, including prospecting, pipeline generation, cold calling, discovery, demos, qualification, and deal progression.
* Build and support enablement programs that help sellers effectively navigate Coram’s **channel and partner motion**.
* Partner with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product, and top\-performing sellers to turn what works in the field into scalable, repeatable plays.
* Define clear success metrics before programs launch and measure impact beyond attendance or completion.
* Use sales data and AI\-powered insights to identify performance gaps, prioritize enablement opportunities, and assess program effectiveness.
* Build scalable processes, playbooks, certifications, and operating rhythms that allow Coram to maintain a high performance bar as the organization grows.
* Facilitate live training, workshops, certifications, and field programs for sellers and sales leaders.
* Travel periodically for onboarding, team events, field enablement, and other company or Sales organization programs.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* New hires become customer\-ready and productive faster, even as onboarding cohorts increase in frequency and size.
* Managers have clear visibility into rep readiness, ramp progress, and areas requiring coaching.
* Sellers consistently execute the behaviors required to generate high\-quality outbound pipeline.
* Sales programs drive measurable improvements in seller behavior, pipeline creation, and revenue performance.
* Sellers are equipped to effectively leverage Coram’s direct and channel motions.
* Best practices from top performers become repeatable across the field.
* Enablement programs are measured by business impact, not activity alone.
* Coram can continue scaling its Sales organization without sacrificing onboarding quality or seller readiness.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Programs, Revenue Enablement, Sales Strategy, or a related GTM role.
* Experience owning or supporting B2B SaaS sales onboarding in a **high\-growth environment**.
* Experience supporting an **outbound\-focused sales organization** and a strong understanding of modern prospecting and pipeline\-generation motions.
* Strong program management, facilitation, and cross\-functional leadership skills.
* Ability to use sales data to identify performance gaps and measure program impact.
* Strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle, from prospecting through close.
* Experience with channel or partner\-led sales motions is a plus.
* Comfortable facilitating live sessions and working directly with sellers and sales leaders.
* Comfortable building programs and processes while the organization, product, and go\-to\-market motion are evolving quickly.
* Willingness to travel periodically based on onboarding, field, and company needs.

**What we offer:**
------------------

* 100% Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance
* Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays
* 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options
* Early\-stage equity in a rapidly growing company
* Referral bonuses
* Daily team breakfast and dinner, and regular team off\-sites
* The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)

new_jobs.company: Life Skills Training and Educational Programs - LifeSTEPS
new_jobs.title: Lead Care Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in peoples lives!**

We're looking for a **Lead Care Managers** for the **Alameda County area!**

**Job Specifics:**

* **Official Job Title:** Lead Care Manager
* **Job classification:** Non\-Exempt, 20 hours per week
* **Job Location:** Position will be working from both remote home office and field locations in the Alameda County, CA area.
* **Pay:** $28\.40 per hour
* **Skills:** Case Management, Health Education, Excellent Documentation

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built One STEP at a time. Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.




**About us**


LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.




**Our Benefits**


In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* LifeSTEPS Perks Program


Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off




**About the Position**


The **Lead Care Manager** under the direction of the Cal AIM Services Director, assists and aids members with enhanced coordination of care.

**Core Duties (*****but not limited to*****) Lead Care Manager:**

* Promote and live out the LifeSTEPS workplace values of integrity, innovation, empowerment, respect and personal growth in tandem with the Oz Principles.
* Follow all LifeSTEPS policies, procedures and guidelines.
* Assess members to identify needs such as personal and family adjustments, finances, employment, food, clothing, housing, and physical and mental impairments to determine nature and degree of assistance.
* Responsible for developing and monitoring the member’s care plan. Responsible for revising member’s care plan as needed.
* Coordinate with external entities providing member with some level of care.
* Coordinate with primary care providers, specialists, behavioral health, community based, long term services and supports needs and oral health providers involved in the care of the member.
* Medication review/reconciliation.
* Scheduling appointments and providing appointment reminders.
* Coordinating transportation and possible accompaniment to critical appointments.
* Identify and help to overcome barriers to adherence to care plan.
* Promote, coordinate and tailor services to meet identified needs.
* Assist members individually, with family, or guardians and caregivers regarding plans for meeting needs; provide culturally appropriate person centered planning, education, training and care instructions and document those activities and the plans for follow up.
* Advocate and refer members to community resources, human services and other organizations as needed.
* Compile records and prepare reports.
* Submit claims to Managed Care Plans (MCP’s) for all member services when required.
* Maintain all required client data in the mylifesteps.org database on a continuous, regular basis. Ensure entries are up to date prior to each weekly supervision call.
* Complete all administrative assignments including timely data entry in multiple databases.
* Review service plan and perform follow ups to determine quantity and quality of services provided members and status of member cases.
* Access and record member and community resource information.
* Secure supplementary information such as employment, medical records, or school reports as needed.
* Study and assess strength and weakness of existing resources.
* Provides comprehensive housing transitions and housing tenancy navigation support to members eligible for services
* Completes screenings and assessments to identify housing needs and factors contributing to housing instability, including functional, environmental, employment, educational, and health information, as appropriate. Identifies and facilitates access to suitable housing options for members, as well as application processes, move in activities, rental negotiations and service referrals. Conduct facility and habitability inspections, as needed.
* Facilitates access to supportive services such as job training, life skills development, legal services financial resources and health care providers.
* Fosters working relationships with property management firms, property owners, housing services agencies and housing advocacy organizations. Engage with landlords and familiarize them with LifeSTEPS housing services and community resources to assist in preventing and addressing tenant issues.
* Provide culturally appropriate health education information and outreach in community based settings, such as homes, clinics, shelters, local businesses, and community centers for various Managed Care Plan (MCP) members.

**Education and/or Experience and/or License Certification:**

new_jobs.title: ICWA Partnership & Implementation Lead
new_jobs.description:
The Technical Expert II (TE II) is a child welfare subject matter expert working collaboratively with TEs and project leadership and is responsible for ensuring the design and delivery of training and technical assistance (T/TA) and deliverables for/with JBS projects and initiatives. The TE II may provide coaching and guidance for and with staff and consultants/collaborators in supporting and implementing effective, high\-quality T/TA and communicate with the JBS client(s) per established project guidelines. The TE II *may* also be called upon to supervise project\-affiliated JBS staff.


The ICWA Partnership and Implementation Lead serves as NCWCIA’s primary implementation support lead within the cross\-center ICWA Technical Assistance Collaborative. The lead works directly with State/County, Tribal, and court partners participating in Community\-Based Partnerships and other ICWA technical assistance activities to strengthen the implementation of the Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA). The position serves as a bridge between the ICWA Technical Assistance Collaborative and NCWCIA’s broader service array, helping partners translate ICWA requirements into sustainable policies, practices, workflows, supervision structures, data systems, and continuous quality improvement efforts.


**In this role, the ICWA Partnership and Implementation Lead will be expected to:**


* Build and maintain collaborative relationships with Tribal, State/County, and court partners participating in the ICWA initiative.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and implementation advisor for State and/or county child welfare agencies participating in Community\-Based Partnerships (CBPs), ICWA technical assistance activities, and Title IV\-B ICWA implementation efforts.
* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of partner needs related to ICWA implementation, including inquiry and notice, active efforts, placement preferences, qualitied expert witnesses (QEWs), transfer of jurisdiction, AFCARS implementation, and State/County\-Tribal\-Court collaboration.
* Assist jurisdictions in translating ICWA requirements into day\-to\-day practice through policy review, workflow development, implementation planning, and problem\-solving.
* Collaborate with Children’s Bureau (CB) partners and CB funded technical assistance providers to support coordinated cross\-center technical assistance.
* Support Community\-Based Partnership teams through planning, facilitation, implementation support, follow\-up, and coordination of resources and expertise.
* Work with NCWCIA Data and CQI staff to help partners use AFCARS and other data to strengthen implementation, monitor progress, and inform continuous improvement efforts.
* Identify opportunities to connect jurisdictions with NCWCIA expertise in prevention, permanency, workforce, community and systems insights, performance and outcomes, peer networking, and continuous quality improvement.
* Support the development of implementation tools, workflows, practice guides, resource materials, and other products that emerge from Community\-Based Partnerships and peer learning activities.
* Provide content review and input on reports, presentations, implementation plans, and technical assistance products.
* Serve as a collaborative partner in identifying emerging implementation challenges, promising practices, and opportunities for innovation across jurisdictions.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Maintain professional expertise in assigned content areas and remain current on emerging issues, policies, regulations, evidence\-informed practices, and trends relevant to child welfare, human services, and the Indian Child Welfare Act (ICWA).
* Design, deliver, and support high\-quality training and technical assistance activities that meet client, contract, and project requirements.
* Maintain communication with clients, partners, consultants, and project staff; participate in meetings and provide consultation, guidance, and recommendations regarding effective technical assistance approaches.


* Collaborate with project leadership, technical experts, and partners to identify needs, analyze challenges, support problem\-solving, and develop strategies for improving system performance and outcomes.
* Support the planning, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of project activities, ensuring timely completion of deliverables and technical assistance commitments.
* Identify and communicate emerging issues, promising practices, lessons learned, and opportunities for innovation to clients, partners, and project staff.
* Facilitate collaboration and information\-sharing across partners and projects to support coordinated service delivery and learning.
* Develop, contribute to, and review written products and deliverables, including reports, presentations, tools, guidance documents, meeting summaries, and technical assistance materials.
* Guide and support project staff, consultants, and partners in carrying out technical assistance activities and may supervise staff as assigned.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation of technical assistance activities in accordance with project and contractual requirements.
* Participate in project planning, quality improvement, proposal development, and business development activities as assigned.

**Minimum Job Qualifications:**


**Education:**


* Master’s degree in relevant field.


**Experience:**


* At least 15 years of relevant work experience.
* Demonstrated expertise in public child welfare systems and child welfare practice.
* Demonstrated knowledge of ICWA implementation, Tribal\-State\-child welfare partnerships, and child welfare system improvement efforts.
* Experience working with Tribal Nations and Tribal child welfare programs.
* Experience providing technical assistance, consultation, facilitation, coaching, or practice improvement support.
* Experience supporting implementation of federal child welfare requirements and initia

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Program Management and Execution**


* Manage Cogency programs from kickoff through completion, anticipating needs and providing proactive communication to subscribers and stakeholders.
* Lead end\-to\-end coordination of live, virtual, and hybrid programs, including attendee recruitment, invitations, RSVP and calendar management, travel, honoraria, expenses, audiovisual requirements, and onsite or virtual execution.
* Partner with internal stakeholders on program planning, execution strategy, issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ability to travel within the United States approximately 25% of the time.

  


**Stakeholder, Faculty, and Vendor Management**


* Serve as a primary point of contact for faculty, clients, vendors, and internal teams, building trusted relationships and escalating issues as needed.
* Select and manage venues and vendors in alignment with program requirements, budget expectations, and compliance standards.

  


**Compliance, Documentation, and Budget Oversight**


* Apply and reinforce SOPs and established processes to support consistent, compliant program delivery.
* Maintain accurate program data, records, payments, and documentation to support compliance, reporting, and performance analysis.
* Manage program budgets proactively, ensuring work remains within approved scope and budget parameters.

  


**Team Guidance and Quality Standards**


* Provide day\-to\-day guidance to Cogency team members on complex programs, best practices, quality standards, and consistent execution.
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Minimum of 3 years of meeting or event planning experience, including responsibility for complex programs; pharmaceutical experience preferred.
* Live, onsite event experience required.
* Demonstrated knowledge of pharmaceutical event operations, industry compliance standards, and related documentation requirements.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple complex programs simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to interact effectively with senior\-level stakeholders.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and speaker bureau or meeting management systems.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate risks, resolve issues, and make sound decisions in a fast\-paced environment.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy, with the ability to maintain compliant, audit\-ready program records, budgets, payments, and related documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate faculty, vendors, venues, travel, audiovisual needs, and other logistics for live, virtual, and hybrid programs.
* Ability to provide informal guidance to team members on SOPs, program execution standards, issue resolution, and quality expectations.


The Senior Program Coordinator oversees the delivery of complex third\-party speaker programs across multiple clients. This role manages program execution from planning through completion, ensures alignment with industry compliance standards, and partners closely with HCP faculty, pharmaceutical clients, vendors, and internal teams to deliver high\-quality programs in a fast\-paced environment. The Senior Program Coordinator also provides guidance to junior team members, reinforces established processes, and helps promote consistent program execution across Cogency.

  


**About Petauri**



Certified as a 2026 Great Place to Work®, Petauri takes pride in having a culture rooted in trust, collaboration, and a strong sense of community. We seek to attract individuals from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join us in our mission of improving patient outcomes by accelerating access to life changing healthcare innovations. A global healthcare consulting and solutions organization, Petauri brings together decades of experience across market access, evidence generation, medical communications, commercialization strategy, and policy to help life sciences organizations navigate complex healthcare challenges with clarity, integrity, and impact.



\#LI\-remote


**About Petauri Advance**



Petauri Advance is the organization’s collective of medical and scientific communication platforms (Bluprint Oncology, Verascity, Cogency, Drive, Propel, and Momentum—All Powered by Petauri). Grounded in scientific expertise, the teams deliver innovative medical communication strategies that transform evidence into understanding, which in turn empowers informed decisions and advances patient care.

new_jobs.description:
**Who we are:**



At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast\-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.



We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.



Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

 **To be eligible for this role you must be able to work remotely and reside only in the approved states of FL, GA, ID, NC, TX, WA \& MI.**
### **Your Responsibilities:**



HR Operations \& Systems


* System Ownership: Support the administration and optimization of Workday and other HRIS tools; troubleshoot issues and ensure data integrity across the platform.
* Lifecycle Support: Execute the operational transactions of key employee milestones, including compensation adjustments, promotions, terminations, and onboarding.
* Data \& Analytics: Design and maintain real\-time dashboards; provide actionable reporting on turnover, headcount, and other key organizational metrics.
* Process Engineering: Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and document workflows to scale HR operations effectively.


  

Benefits \& Wellness Administration:
* Program Management: Lead the day\-to\-day administration of global health and wellness programs, acting as the primary point of contact for employee inquiries.
* Financial Oversight: Execute the benefit reconciliation process and ensure accurate, timely processing of all carrier billing.
* Leave of Absence (LOA): Coordinate and track leave programs (FMLA, Disability, etc.) ensuring a supportive experience for employees and compliance with all regulations.
* Perk Optimization: Assist in the evaluation and rollout of employee perks to enhance the overall employee value proposition.

Compliance \& Governance:
* Regulatory Filings: Direct the preparation and submission of information required for EEO\-1, ADA, FMLA, and Department of Labor audits.
* Policy Development: Draft or revise internal HR policies to ensure they remain current with changing local, state, and federal labor laws.
* Audit Readiness: Maintain rigorous documentation standards for OSHA and other governmental reporting requirements.
### **Your Qualifications:**

* Experience with Workday and other HR Systems such as absence management software, ticketing tools, etc.
* Demonstrated experience supporting corporate health and wellness benefits as well as leave of absence programs
* Strong mindset for continuous improvement, process streamlining, increasing efficiency and meeting or exceeding client expectations
* Proven project management and operations skills with demonstrated ability to manage global projects and initiatives
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with proven ability to organize and analyze data, using HRIS systems for reporting
* Ability to establish strong relationships and credibility at all levels and geographies throughout the organization and cross\-functionally
* Comfort with ambiguity; ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Broad knowledge of HR functional disciplines (e.g., organizational development, talent management, employee relations, staffing, and compensation/benefits)
* In\-depth understanding of federal, state and local laws relating to HR
* A Bachelor's degree with 3\-5 years of directly relevant experience in HR/Benefits Operations


### **Benefits of Working at Rover.com**

* Competitive compensation
* 401k match
* Long\-term incentive plan with a company performance\-based cash payout
* Flexible PTO
* Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Commuter benefits
* Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
* Pet benefits, including $1000 toward adopting your first dog or cat
* Stocked fridges, coffee, soda, and lots of treats (for humans and dogs) and free catered lunches monthly
* Regular team activities performed in\-person and virtually
### **Compensation:**

* In the greater Seattle area the first\-year salary range is $91,485\-$117,902\. In Washington State outside of the Seattle area the first\- year salary range is $83,168\-$107,183\. Additionally, Rover offers a long\-term incentive plan with a company performance\-based cash payout and benefits to full\-time employees.
* The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.
At Rover, we’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, while doing our jobs better than ever before. We believe the best business outcomes come from a diverse set of perspectives and we’re committed to promoting an inclusive, inventive, and fun environment with amazing employees. Rover is an equal opportunity employer. new_jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description:**


Raftelis helps local governments and utilities thrive by providing management consulting expertise to help transform local governments and utilities. We've provided professional consulting services to more than 700 organizations in the last year alone. We work in all areas of management consulting including finance, assessment, communications, technology, executive recruitment, and strategic planning.


We're proud to share that Raftelis has been certified as a Great Place to Work®! As one of our employees said, “at Raftelis, we maintain a great balance between hard work and allowing staff to focus on their lives outside of work. We also have a strong culture where people genuinely care about each other, and leadership is committed to doing what's best for both our employees and the firm”.


**Job Summary:**


Raftelis created Rafio, an AI agent built to make the people who serve utilities and local governments more capable, delivering intelligence they can trust and stand behind. The Customer Success Lead owns the post\-sale relationship: developing the agreement for new clients once demo and interest have been established, then owning that relationship from kickoff through confident, independent daily use and beyond. This is a hands\-on, technical customer success role. The single biggest driver of sustained usage is integration: connecting Rafio to the systems and data a customer already utilizes. You will be expected to scope, build, and troubleshoot those integrations yourself, working alongside other team members. You will also serve as the liaison between the client and the platform team, quarterbacking requests and triaging work to the right people when a need falls outside your direct support. You will report directly to the Chief Technology Officer, own the function solo at the start, and build a team as the customer base grows.


Success in this role is measured by usage that grows, customers who trust the output enough to lean on it, and a retention\-and\-expansion trajectory that becomes a revenue engine for the company.


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Develop the client agreement once demo and interest have been established, converting engaged prospects into signed customers.
* Own onboarding end to end: take a newly signed customer from kickoff to confident, independent daily use.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the client and the platform team: quarterback requests, triage issues, and direct work to the right team members when a need falls outside your direct support.
* Deploy the platform inside the customer's real, often messy environment, rather than waiting for a clean hand\-off.
* Scope, build, and troubleshoot integrations that connect Rafio to the customer's existing systems and data, since integrations are the critical driver of usage\-based growth.
* Carry a net revenue retention and expansion target: drive growing usage across each account, identify expansion opportunities, and act on them.
* Earn and protect customer trust with a risk\-averse, accountable buyer, ensuring the output is correct and defensible because trust is the foundation of the relationship.
* Build the repeatable systems a solo function needs to scale: self\-service resources, documentation, onboarding playbooks, training, and tooling.
* Run customer enablement and education so users become proficient and self\-sufficient, not dependent on support.
* Close the loop with product: translate what you see in real deployments into clear, prioritized feedback for the engineering team.
* Build and lead the customer success team as the customer base grows.
* Other duties assigned

**Requirements:**


* Hands\-on technical ability. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to build. You can scope and wire an integration, work through an API, read documentation, and troubleshoot why a connection is not behaving, without waiting for someone else to do the technical part. On a small team, the person who owns success also helps on the platform.
* Change management understanding. You have stood up software inside someone else's environment before, where the data was messy and the process undefined, and you made it work. You are drawn to getting a customer genuinely live and using the product, not to managing a relationship from a distance.
* The ability to earn trust with a careful buyer. You have worked with risk\-averse, accountable customers, in government, education, healthcare, finance, or another high\-trust, regulated setting, and you understand that with this buyer, correctness and credibility come before everything else.
* An owner's mindset about retention and growth. You think in terms of durable, growing usage and expansion, not just keeping accounts from leaving. You have owned a number, a book of business, or a unit's outcomes before, and you are energized by being accountable for whether usage and revenue grow.
* A process and scaling mentality. Before you scale yourself with headcount, you scale yourself with systems: documentation, self\-service, repeatable playbooks, and better tooling. You have built the operational backbone that lets a small function serve a growing customer base.
* A product sensibility. You notice where a new user gets lost and you care about the first\-run experience. You can turn what you observe in real deployments into clear, useful feedback that makes the product better.
* A teacher's patience. You can take a non\-technical user from confused to confident, and you would rather build a customer who is self\-sufficient than one who depends on you. Prior experience teaching, training, or building enablement is a strong plus.
* Alignment with our mission. We serve organizations that exist to serve their communities. You share the conviction that better tools in the hands of those operators improve the everyday lives of the people they serve.

We are open to candidates from a wide range of industries and backgroun

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12\), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI \- rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.



Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

new_jobs.description:
DaySmart supercharges experienced\-based businesses with innovative, industry\-specific software services that power customer and revenue growth. With thousands of partners worldwide and dozens of industry awards, we provide best\-in\-class solutions to accelerate their business.


**About the Role**  

DaySmart Recreation is looking for a hands\-on Sales \& Revenue Operations leader to help our sales teams operate with greater clarity, consistency and efficiency across our portfolio of recreation software businesses.  

Supporting Sawyer, TeamUp and Dash, this person will be a key operating partner to Recreation leadership and our Sales and Marketing teams. You will own the sales forecast, pipeline discipline, sales process and operating cadence that help us understand performance, identify gaps early, improve seller productivity and make better decisions about where to focus.

  

  

You will not be doing this alone. Core sales reporting and scorecards are being built by a dedicated data team, and day\-to\-day CRM administration is handled by our systems partner. Your job is to put those inputs to work: interpret what the numbers are saying, decide what should change, and drive the fix with sales leaders.

  

  

This is an individual\-contributor leadership role. We are looking for someone who can move easily between analysis and execution — from diagnosing why conversion changed or tightening the forecast to redesigning a qualification step or helping a sales leader see where their team is losing opportunities.  

The goal is simple: help our teams sell more effectively and give leadership a clear, actionable view of what is happening across the revenue funnel.

  

  

**What You'll Own**


* **Sales Performance \& Operating Rhythm**
	+ Partner with sales leaders to identify performance gaps, understand root causes and establish clear actions.
	+ Lead monthly sales performance reviews and support broader Recreation operating reviews.
	+ Translate the reporting and scorecards produced by the data team into a clear narrative for leadership: what moved, why, and what we are doing about it.
* **Forecasting \& Pipeline**
	+ Own and continually improve the sales forecasting process.
	+ Establish consistent pipeline definitions, stage criteria, hygiene standards and inspection processes.
	+ Partner with sales leaders on pipeline coverage, rep productivity, quotas and capacity, working with the data team on the underlying analysis.
	+ Identify bottlenecks and leakage throughout the sales funnel and recommend changes to improve conversion.
	+ Help leadership understand where we are likely to outperform or miss before the results happen.
* **Sales Process \& Productivity**
	+ Identify opportunities to simplify processes and help sellers spend more time selling.
	+ Design and implement improvements across lead management, qualification, demos, follow\-up, pipeline management and closing.
	+ Standardize best practices where appropriate across Sawyer, TeamUp and Dash while recognizing the differences between each business.
	+ Evaluate tools, automation and AI capabilities that can meaningfully improve seller productivity.
	+ Create scalable processes rather than relying on manual work or individual knowledge.
* **Marketing \& Sales Funnel**
	+ Partner closely with Marketing to understand lead volume, quality, attribution and conversion.
	+ Analyze performance by acquisition channel and identify where funnel performance is improving or deteriorating.
	+ Help design and measure GTM experiments across forms, segmentation, demo/trial flows and sales motions.
	+ Ensure Sales teams understand Demand Generation initiatives and have visibility into what is driving their pipeline.
* **Systems \& Data Partnership**
	+ Act as the voice of Sales to the data team and our CRM/systems partner: define requirements, prioritize requests and make sure what gets built solves real seller and leadership problems.
	+ Own the business definitions behind key sales metrics so the data team, Finance and sales leaders are working from the same numbers.
	+ Flag where systems or data quality are creating friction for sellers and drive the fix through the right owner.
* **Planning \& Strategic Analysis**
	+ Support annual and quarterly sales planning, including targets, quotas, headcount, capacity and productivity assumptions.
	+ Build models and analyses to support investment and resource decisions.
	+ Partner with Finance to align sales forecasts and revenue plans.
	+ Turn data into clear recommendations — not simply dashboards.

**About You**


* 5\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations or a related role, with at least some of that time owning forecasting or pipeline for a sales team.
* Experience supporting SMB SaaS sales organizations, ideally with high\-volume inbound sales motions.
* Deep understanding of sales funnels, pipeline management, forecasting, rep productivity and SaaS metrics.
* Strong working knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot or similar) and how sales processes are configured within them; you do not need to be the administrator, but you need to know what good looks like.

* Maintain accurate contract metadata (i.e. contract names, TINs, and administrative details) to ensure seamless downstream data integration into reporting and product platforms.
* Investigate and resolve manual care gap upload failures to ensure complete and accurate data ingestion.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Collaborate with internal teams—including Payer Solutions, Product, Engineering, and Field Operations—and payer partners to intake, investigate, route, and resolve data issues.
* Communicate complex data findings and technical concepts clearly to diverse technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

* Serve as a subject matter expert on Aledade’s payer data, analyzing feed and metric anomalies to empower internal teams to optimize patient care and achieve contract objectives.

**Program Management**


* Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for data issue triage, clinical ingestion troubleshooting, and Primary Source Verification (PSV) audits.

Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward\-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.


As an Account Manager at Maestro, part of the Fullsteam organization, you are responsible for driving expansion growth within our customer base. Your primary responsibility will be to foster strong relationships with existing clients, identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling, and ensure their continued satisfaction and loyalty to our software solutions and services...  



  

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within the existing customer base through phone, video, email and face to face to understand their business goals and challenges.
* Create and execute strategic account plans to identify growth opportunities and drive expansion within assigned accounts.
* Deeply understand customers business needs and match to qualifying products and solutions.
* Identify and pursue opportunities to upsell and cross\-sell additional products and services that align with customer needs and objectives.
* Serve as the voice of the customer within the organization, advocating for their needs and ensuring they receive the highest level of service.
* Proactively manage contract renewals, ensuring high renewal rates and preventing churn.
* Collaborate with the Customer Success team to ensure customers are successfully adopting and leveraging our solutions to achieve their desired outcomes.
* Address and resolve customer issues and concerns in a timely and effective manner, coordinating with internal teams as needed.
* Maintain an accurate record of sales activities, leads, and opportunities in the CRM system. Develop and manage a sales pipeline of opportunities to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual targets. Leverage sales dashboards to understand where to focus your time and activities.
* Provide regular updates and reports on account status, growth opportunities, and customer satisfaction metrics to management.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to think strategically and identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
* Strong understanding of sales processes and techniques for upselling and cross\-selling.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and persuasively.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to address and resolve customer issues effectively.
* Deep commitment to customer satisfaction and success, with a proactive and customer\-centric approach.
* Ability to analyze customer data, market trends, and account metrics to inform strategy and decision\-making.
* Exceptional organizational and time management skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.
* In\-depth understanding of the software technology industry and market dynamics.
* Outstanding knowledge of MS Office and proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and customer success tools.
* Fast and adaptative learner, focused on improving customer and business processes.
* Advanced negotiation skills.
* Driven by achieving and exceeding targets, with a strong focus on results.

**Experience and Education Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field preferred.
* Prior PMS experience highly preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in software sales preferred

The primary focus is ensuring our clients achieve \& exceed their desired marketing goals through strategic campaign planning, and data analysis. As the Account Manager, you will act as the primary point of contact for client concerns and needs post\-sales.
  
Must possess strong expertise in existing \& emerging business marketing solutions, coupled with the ability to collaborate with our sales partners, post sales optimizers to identify opportunities, and effectively deliver solutions that maximize a client's ROI; are minimum expectations. In this dynamic role, a change\-minded person will be crucial for effectively navigating the ever\-evolving landscape of digital and traditional marketing concepts. Seamlessly, the AM will integrate with various teams and adapt to new challenges, ensuring that strategies remain agile and responsive to client needs.
  
  

**Position Requirements:**  

* Closely partner with sales team(s), in owning the client relationship by: building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, \& delivering results against joint business objectives
* Understand, manage, and anticipate client expectations, gain client alignment, and fully mobilize/engage partner teams against the aligned approach while maintaining a strong communicative relationship
* Create a consistent open line of communication ensuring our value story \& service successes are in parallel to a client's needs/goals via performance reviews (Weekly, Monthly, etc.)
* Articulate media programs to devise appropriate strategies and campaign implementation plans
* Work alongside our sales, and post sales optimization teams to formulate and act upon appropriate digital strategies and executions. These actions will aid in meeting and exceeding our clients' business goals.
* Advise our clients on how best to leverage feasible ongoing and impending marketing strategies
* Ensure a highly consistent marketing message across paid search, organic presence, display, social media, and O\&O digital/print marketing channels
* Daily proficiency in customer relationship management, online search, and display advertising techniques and LocaliQ proprietary technologies
* Review day to day campaign performance in collaboration with post sales optimization counterparts, assess digital campaign trends, facilitate client advertising performance discussions, \& identify proactively creative new advertising techniques to further our client’s digital marketing needs
* Hold primary responsibility for communicating and collaborating with backend support resources including, but not limited to, various digital solutions and ad operations teams, focused on delivering and exceeding client objectives (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, As Needed)


**Key Skills:**  

* Ability to quickly master business process, marketing, and technology concepts
* Demonstrated expertise in customer relationship management
* Mastery of key technologies and systems to review and advise on digital marketing campaigns
* Advanced capabilities to effectively understand and speak toward digital advertising campaigns –Search, Display, Marketing Management Systems, traditional marketing endeavors etc.
* Strong technical skills to recommend, assess, modify/adjust, \& routinely improve marketing campaigns over their lifecycle
* Demonstrated expertise with digital marketing publishing systems \& processes
* Excellent verbal \& written communication skills
* Demonstrate understanding of how retail/service media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive a business
* Proven track record in relationship building and account management
* Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes \& workflows
* Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills required


**Key Competencies:**  

* Marketing Concepts \& Digital Marketing Acumen: pay\-per\-click, programmatic display, social, email marketing, and tracking concepts (Analytics/GA4\), Leads, etc.)
* Customer Focus
* Proactive Creative \& Analytical Thinking
* Business Process \& Technology Acumen
* Team Collaboration
*

new_jobs.title: Customer Experience Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Presence**



Presence is the leading provider of teletherapy solutions for children with diverse needs. Our award\-winning technology connects speech\-language pathologists, school psychologists, occupational therapists, and mental health specialists to K\-12 school districts nationwide. With a growing network of over 2,000 clinicians and more than 8 million teletherapy sessions delivered, we're dedicated to ensuring every child has access to the support they need.



At Presence, we embrace the benefits of being a remote\-first company while recognizing the importance of in\-person connection to advance our mission. We place a high value on "cameras on" engagement, schedule coordination, and cross\-functional communication to stay connected while working in different places. Travel is also an important part of many roles, helping us build stronger relationships with our teams, clinicians, and school partners. The frequency will vary by role and responsibilities, but may include activities such as department offsites, team gatherings, and school or industry events.


**About the role:**



Customer Experience Specialist will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our technology platform meets the needs of a growing number of districts, providers, and teachers. This role is designed for an experienced Customer Experience professional who can independently manage a portfolio of school and district partners, lead complex implementations and customer initiatives, and serve as a strategic advisor throughout the entirety of the customer lifecycle. The CX Specialist will drive onboarding, adoption, engagement, value realization, satisfaction, and retention while proactively identifying risk and helping customers achieve measurable outcomes. This role reports into the Manager of Customer Experience.



To stay connected, all employees commit to being available on\-camera during our Core Working Hours (Monday \- Friday, 12 \- 5 p.m. ET) with standard business hours of 9 a.m. \- 6 p.m. in your local time zone. For this role, up to 10% travel may be required to help you connect in\-person in a meaningful way.


**What will you do at Presence:**



As a strategic advisor on SaaS, the customer experience lead guides customers and external stakeholders to maximize the platform's effectiveness and commercial growth:


* Lead onboarding and training for customers on SaaS platforms Kanga and Education Modified
* Conduct initial and ongoing product training tailored to customer goals, roles, workflows, and levels of adoption
* Develop success plans with customers that connect platform usage and engagement to clearly defined goals, desired outcomes, and measures of value
* Leverage insights from school customers to guide product development that maximizes adoption and impact
* Develop key metrics to measure the engagement of users over time, continuously improving strategies to strengthen user adoption and satisfaction
* Innovate on existing SaaS customer systems to capture real\-time KPIs that measure customer satisfaction
* Develop and maintain KPIs for customer health, retention, and operational performance


This role demands exceptional customer engagement, driving adoption for superior outcomes for students and schools. You will partner closely with Implementation, Sales, and Analytics


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**


**Retention \& Customer Outcomes**


* Gross and Net Revenue Retention (GRR / NRR)
* Health score accuracy (predictive vs. actual outcomes)
* Product adoption metrics
* Reduction in escalations and churn drivers


**Operational Excellence**


* Forecast accuracy (retention and risk)
* Process consistency and adherence
* Automation adoption and workflow efficiency


**What we are looking for:**


* 3\+ years of experience in Customer Success, account management, implementation, or a consultative customer\-facing role, preferably in SaaS or education technology
* Has the ability to self\-start and work independently, while being part of a fast\-paced, collaborative team
* Passion for mission\-driven impact in education and innovation
* Proven track record of leading systems initiatives from planning to execution
* Strong analytical skills to maintain overview of customer experience to address customer pain points
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to win over key constituents
* Strong leadership qualities and the ability to influence and motivate others


**What will help you succeed here:**


* You actively listen and respond with empathy, fostering respectful and productive collaboration
* You maintain a strong service mindset, consistently meeting the needs of internal and external stakeholders while building trust and credibility
* You seek creative, effective solutions and persist beyond the first answer to find what truly works
* You make thoughtful, informed decisions that align with company goals, and you're not afraid to ask questions to gain clarity
* You deliver high\-quality work on time, and you proactively seek support or guidance when challenges arise


**How we support you:**


* Comprehensive benefit plans, including medical with a High Deductible Plan and generous HSA contribution, plus dental and vision coverage
* In addition to 11 observed holidays, salaried team members have flexible paid time off and hourly team members accrue 15 days paid time off starting
* 401K savings plan with a discretionary company match
* $500 home office stipend
* Benefits package including company\-paid life insurance, AD\&D, Employee Assistance Program, and disability benefits
* Wellness programs with Headspace, Peloton and One Medical
* Paid parental and caregiving leave
* Professional Development opportunities \- eligibility to apply for our scholarship program
* Collaborative, inclusive, and fun culture that is recognized as Great Place to Work certified
* Employee Resource Groups to promote shared community and belonging
* A meaningfu

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Total Expert is the Customer Operating System for financial services. Our purpose\-built platform combines a system of context with a system of action that enables humans and AI Assistants to engage in the moments that matter and earn customers for life. Since 2016 Total Expert has enabled more than seven trillion dollars of funded loan volume.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) plays a vital role in building strong, strategic partnerships between Total Expert and our mid\-market customers. CSMs are trusted advisors who help customers realize maximum value and ROI from the Total Expert platform. By combining industry expertise, product knowledge, and a deep understanding of customer challenges, CSMs guide organizations toward achieving their business objectives and accelerating revenue growth. The work you do empowers tens of thousands of financial services leaders to help their customers make confident, life\-shaping financial decisions.


***For candidates based in the Dallas, TX or Minneapolis, MN area, the position follows a hybrid schedule with 3 on\-site days per week. This position would be remote for qualifying candidates residing outside of those areas.***



**What you’ll be doing:**



* Champion Customer Success: Promote and communicate the full value of Total Expert’s products and services to help customers achieve measurable results.
* Understand the Ecosystem: Gain deep knowledge of each customer’s tech stack, system integrations, and dependencies to optimize their use of Total Expert.
* Be a Trusted Advisor: Build and maintain long\-term relationships by recommending workflows, best practices, and strategic guidance tailored to each customer’s goals.
* Drive Retention and Growth: Lead contract renewals and identify upsell or cross\-sell opportunities within your portfolio of accounts.
* Ensure Customer Satisfaction: Monitor sentiment and engagement to proactively drive retention and reduce risk.
* Measure Success: Track and report progress toward the customer’s definition of success, demonstrating clear business value over time.
* Develop Executive Relationships: Engage with stakeholders across all levels—including executives—to understand key objectives, challenges, and performance indicators.
* Conduct Business Reviews: Lead regular strategic and operational reviews to assess outcomes, alignment, and next steps.
* Optimize Processes: Partner with customers to improve efficiencies, streamline workflows, and maximize platform productivity.
* Increase Adoption and Engagement: Drive active usage, deliver training, and promote adoption of new features and functionality.
* Advocate for the Customer: Serve as the customer’s voice within Total Expert, collaborating cross\-functionally to address needs and influence product enhancements.
* Document and Report: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of customer interactions, success plans, and engagement history within our customer success platform.
* Contribute to a Growth Culture: Continuously looking for ways to enhance customer experiences and internal processes.
**What we are looking for:**



* Self\-Starter with Growth Mindset: Ability to work independently with a strong desire to learn, adapt, and grow.
* Thrives in Startup Culture: Resilient, resourceful, curious, and energized by a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Tech\-Savvy and Passionate: Enthusiasm for technology, innovation, and driving success in a growing SaaS company.
* Strategic Relationship Builder: Proven ability to manage complex, multi\-divisional, and geographically diverse accounts.
* Customer\-Centric Mindset: A genuine passion for delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes for customers.
* Decisive Problem Solver: Skilled at analyzing complex challenges, identifying root causes, and developing strategic solutions that align with both customer and company goals.
* Cross\-Functional Collaborator: Experience partnering effectively with Sales, Product, Professional Services, and Support teams to drive success.
* Executive Credibility: Ability to communicate and establish trust with stakeholders at all organizational levels, including C\-suite executives.
* Strong Multitasker: Capable of managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines under pressure.
* Positive and Energetic: High energy, flexibility, and a proactive “can\-do” attitude in the face of challenges.
* Excellent Communicator: Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills; comfortable translating technical details into business value.
* Organized and Analytical: Exceptional time management, problem\-solving, and analytical abilities.
* Proficient in Tools: Highly skilled in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and process mapping tools.
* Up to 25% travel required
**What sets our top performers apart:**



* Experience in the mortgage industry preferred
* Experience with the Total Expert platform a plus
* 3\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Management Consulting (or a similar client\-facing role)
* 2\+ years of experience in a SaaS or technology organization
* Experience in financial services, marketing automation, or CRM platforms a plus

**Compensation/Benefits**: The anticipated base salary range for this role is $75,000 \- $90,000 annually. **Job Title:** Sales Manager / Key Account Manager \- East Coast  

**Reports to:** Sales Director  

**FLSA Class:** Exempt

 **Learn more about our company and how we support you:**


The surgical robot that assists a surgeon. The autonomous vehicle that navigates a warehouse floor. The train control system that keeps thousands of commuters on schedule. Somewhere inside that technology is an ADLINK product.


Ampro ADLINK Technology designs and manufactures embedded computing hardware for industries where failure is not an option. Industrial automation, robotics, autonomous vehicles, healthcare, and intelligent transportation are just some of the markets we serve. Our products sit at the edge of these systems, processing data and providing real\-time control where it happens, when it happens, not in a distant cloud.


Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Taiwan, we operate across the US, UK, Singapore, China, Japan, Korea, and Germany with products deployed in more than 40 countries. Our San Jose office drives our business across the Americas and works closely with technology partners, including Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, and NXP.


If you are an experienced sales professional who wants to sell to some of the most exciting companies in the world, autonomous vehicle manufacturers, casino gaming platforms, medical device makers, robotics innovators, and more, ADLINK gives you a genuine competitive edge. Our technology is deeply embedded in our customers' products, which means long\-term relationships, recurring business, and deals that are worth winning.

 **Job Summary:**  

  

ADLINK is looking for a Sales Manager to cover and support the East Coast team, or a Key Account Manager (Both will be considered).


The right individual is a talented, experienced, fearless and highly competitive sales professional that thrives in an outbound proactive prospecting role and will be responsible for evangelizing, promoting, and selling ADLINK’s products to new and existing customers within a region.


The successful candidate will play a fundamental role in achieving our customer acquisition and revenue growth objectives in the East US territory, preferably located in the Boston area or in the East Coast territory.  

  

**The Sales Manager is remote**  

**Approximately 50% travel may be required.**

 **Essential Job Functions (include, but are not limited to the following):**

* Develop new OEM accounts.
* Design and implement sales strategies to ensure the company meets its revenue and design win objectives.
* Use insight and consultative selling techniques to teach customers about their industry and offer unique perspectives on their business, which link back to ADLINK’s solutions.
* Research prospective organizations and identify the right customer stakeholders to sell to.
* Coach customer stakeholders and build consensus for ADLINK solutions within their organization.
* Leverage the Challenger Sales methodology and an insights\-driven sales processes, along with a current knowledge of industry and technical trends, to customize solutions for customer needs and business goals.
* Independently and collaboratively strategize for solving deal level challenges.
* Regularly update an accurate and robust pipeline of business opportunities and forecasts in SFDC with latest customer information and use customer intelligence for account planning.
* Prepare weekly and monthly territory sales forecasts and maintain your sales pipeline.
* Track weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance and sales metrics.
* Experience aligning business outcomes and initiatives with technology requirements.
* Manage rep partners.
* Support and manage the relationships with all assigned customers, ensuring high customer satisfaction.
* Cooperate in the annual planning process with Sales management, setting key objectives: design win and revenue targets, new customer targets, new opportunity creation goals, etc.
* Customer visits including giving technical presentations and product overviews to customers.
* As a trusted advisor, build in\-depth knowledge of clients’ business priorities, challenges and initiatives that can be translated into additional ADLINK opportunities.
* This a remote role, but travel is required in this role (customer meetings within territory, annual sales events, etc.).

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline

**Experience:**

* 5\+ years of work experience in the embedded computing industry is a plus, but we focus on the right mindset and individual for this high growth potential position.
* Knowledge of the market, region and customers will be considered a key point in the selection.

**Competencies:**

* Strategic Thinking \- Systematically solves problems and hypothesizes possible customer pain points, expectations, and implicit needs; brainstorms with team members to devise solutions to solve complex deal challenges.
* Communication \- Tailors communication to the customer’s needs with authority; effectively delivers presentations and has strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Interpersonal Influence \- Uses rational and emotion drives that would appeal to customers to drive negotiation conversations in his or her favor.
* Networking \- Identifies the right customer stakeholders and builds connections quickly to drive consensus for deals; works cooperatively with a wide range of internal stakeholders for deal success.
* Workflow Management \- Highly organized with a rapid, yet methodical approach. Sets clear time\-bound objectives that align with business growth.
* Negotiation \- Experience in large complex deal negotiations with a successful track record.
* Ownership \- Goes out of his or her way to complete a job with relentless drive to achieve results; is independent and self\-directed.

 **Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Life, AD\&D, Short Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability insurance
* 401k retirement plan
* HSA, Health Care FSA

Strive Pharmacy is a personalized compounding pharmacy built on a simple conviction: medicine should fit the patient, not the other way around. We started Strive because we believed the pharmaceutical industry was overdue for a more human approach—one that prioritizes individualized care, clinical nuance, and genuine partnership with patients and providers.


Compounding gives us the tools to do that. Every formulation we prepare is built to the specific needs of a specific person, and every interaction we have is guided by that same commitment to personalized care.


We're growing, and we're looking for people who share that conviction. If you're ready to be part of a pharmacy that takes the work seriously and the people even more seriously, we'd like to meet you.


**Mission:**


Strive exists to disrupt an industry long overdue for a more personal approach to care. We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. We're a team on a mission to change what personalized healthcare looks and feels like.
